Bosonize.Ch11.partition_state_order_inde.text: lemma partition_state_order_independent (h : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) {E : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition E) (parts : List ℕ) (hp : (parts : Multiset ℕ) = p.parts) : wordState h N hN parts = partitionState h N hN p

Bosonize.Ch11.partition_states_linear_in.text: lemma partition_states_linear_independent (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K : ℕ) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) : LinearIndependent ℂ (partitionState h N hN (E := K))

Bosonize.Ch11.r2_implies_r1.text: lemma r2_implies_r1 (h K : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) : (K : ℤ) ≤ min ((h : ℤ)+N) ((h : ℤ)-N)

Bosonize.Ch11.remainder_ccr.text: lemma remainder_ccr (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (parts : List ℕ) (hmargin : (m : ℤ)+(n : ℤ)+(parts.sum : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) : A02.commutator (Ch09.rho h (-(m : ℤ))) (Ch09.rho h (n : ℤ)) (wordState h N hN parts) = (if m=n then (m : ℂ) else 0) • wordState h N hN parts

Bosonize.Ch11.right_remainder_margin.text: lemma right_remainder_margin (h K m n : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (parts : List ℕ) (hm : m ≤ K) (hn : n+parts.sum ≤ K) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) : (m : ℤ)+(n : ℤ)+(parts.sum : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch11.word_gram.text: lemma word_gram (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K : ℕ) (left right : List ℕ) (hl : ∀ m ∈ left, 0 < m) (hr : ∀ m ∈ right, 0 < m) (hlK : left.sum ≤ K) (hrK : right.sum ≤ K) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) : inner ℂ (wordState h N hN left) (wordState h N hN right) = if (left : Multiset ℕ) = (right : Multiset ℕ) then (hallFactor (left : Multiset ℕ) : ℂ) else 0

Bosonize.Ch11.word_inner_cons.text: lemma word_inner_cons (h : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (m : ℕ) (left right : List ℕ) : inner ℂ (wordState h N hN (m::left)) (wordState h N hN right) = inner ℂ (wordState h N hN left) (Ch09.rho h (-(m : ℤ)) (wordState h N hN right))

Bosonize.Ch11.word_state_cons.text: lemma word_state_cons (h m : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (parts : List ℕ) : wordState h N hN (m::parts) = Ch09.rho h (m : ℤ) (wordState h N hN parts)

Bosonize.Ch11.word_state_cons_erase.text: lemma word_state_cons_erase (h m : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (parts : List ℕ) (hm : m ∈ parts) : wordState h N hN parts = Ch09.rho h (m : ℤ) (wordState h N hN (parts.erase m))

Bosonize.Ch11.word_state_mem_budget.text: lemma word_state_mem_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (parts : List ℕ) (K : ℕ) (hK : parts.sum ≤ K) : wordState h N hN parts ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch11.word_state_mem_energy.text: lemma word_state_mem_energy (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (parts : List ℕ) : wordState h N hN parts ∈ Ch07.energySpace h N (parts.sum : ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch11.word_state_nil.text: lemma word_state_nil (h : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) : wordState h N hN [] = Ch07.groundKet h N hN

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch12.sugawaraHamiltonian
commands.text:
noncomputable def sugawaraHamiltonian (h M : ℕ) : Operators h :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, Ch09.rho h (m : ℤ) * Ch09.rho h (-(m : ℤ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch12.physicalRelativeHamiltonian
commands.text:
noncomputable def physicalRelativeHamiltonian (h : ℕ) (β : ℝ) : Operators h :=
  Ch09.physicalHamiltonian h β -
    (Ch06Ext.physicalOccupationEnergy (2*h) β (Ch05.seaConfiguration (2*h)) : ℂ) • 1

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch12.physicalExcitationObservable
commands.text:
noncomputable def physicalExcitationObservable (h : ℕ) (β : ℝ) : Operators h :=
  physicalRelativeHamiltonian h β - A03.diagonal (fun S =>
    (Ch06Ext.physicalGroundEnergy β (Ch07.relativeCharge h S) : ℂ))

Bosonize.Ch12.density_bilinear_word.text: lemma density_bilinear_word (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmK : m ≤ K) (parts : List ℕ) (hE : parts.sum ≤ K) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) : (Ch09.rho h (m : ℤ) * Ch09.rho h (-(m : ℤ))) (Ch11.wordState h N hN parts) = ((m*parts.count m : ℕ) : ℂ) • Ch11.wordState h N hN parts

Bosonize.Ch12.excitation_energy_space.text: lemma excitation_energy_space (h : ℕ) (N E : ℤ) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.energySpace h N E) : Ch07.excitationObservable h v = (E : ℂ) • v

Bosonize.Ch12.excitation_partition_eigen.text: lemma excitation_partition_eigenvalue (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (E : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition E) : Ch07.excitationObservable h (Ch11.partitionState h N hN p) = (E : ℂ) • Ch11.partitionState h N hN p

Bosonize.Ch12.ground_energy_complex.text: lemma ground_energy_complex (N : ℤ) : (Ch07.groundEnergy N : ℂ) = (N : ℂ)*((N : ℂ)+1)/2

Bosonize.Ch12.inactive_mode_zero.text: lemma inactive_mode_zero (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (K m : ℕ) (hm : K < m) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : (Ch09.rho h (m : ℤ) * Ch09.rho h (-(m : ℤ))) v = 0

Bosonize.Ch12.physical_excitation_cancel.text: lemma physical_excitation_cancel (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (β : ℝ) : physicalExcitationObservable h β = Ch07.excitationObservable h

Bosonize.Ch12.physical_relative_budget.text: lemma physical_relative_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (β : ℝ) (N : ℤ) (K : ℕ) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : physicalRelativeHamiltonian h β v = Ch05.shiftedHamiltonian (2*h) v + ((β : ℂ)*(N : ℂ)) • v

Bosonize.Ch12.physical_sugawara_budget.text: theorem physical_sugawara_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (β : ℝ) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K M : ℕ) (hM : K ≤ M) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : physicalRelativeHamiltonian h β v = sugawaraHamiltonian h M v + (Ch06Ext.physicalGroundEnergy β N : ℂ) • v

Bosonize.Ch12.positive_word_weight.text: lemma positive_word_weight (K : ℕ) (parts : List ℕ) (hE : parts.sum ≤ K) : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, m*parts.count m = parts.sum

Bosonize.Ch12.relative_energy_budget.text: lemma relative_energy_budget (h : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (K : ℕ) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : Ch05.shiftedHamiltonian (2*h) v = Ch07.excitationObservable h v + (Ch07.groundEnergy N : ℂ) • v

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_adjoint.text: lemma sugawara_adjoint (h M : ℕ) : LinearMap.adjoint (sugawaraHamiltonian h M) = sugawaraHamiltonian h M

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_apply.text: lemma sugawara_apply (h M : ℕ) (v : FockSpace h) : sugawaraHamiltonian h M v = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, Ch09.rho h (m : ℤ) (Ch09.rho h (-(m : ℤ)) v)

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_budget_partition_.text: lemma sugawara_budget_partition_eigenvalue (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K M : ℕ) (hM : K ≤ M) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) (p : Ch11.BudgetPartitions K) : sugawaraHamiltonian h M (Ch11.budgetPartitionState h N hN p) = (p.1.val : ℂ) • Ch11.budgetPartitionState h N hN p

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_commutator_witnes.text: lemma sugawara_commutator_witness (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (M n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hM : n ≤ M) (hR2 : 2*n ≤ h) : ∃ v : FockSpace h, v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h 0 0 ∧ v ≠ 0 ∧ Ch09.rho h (n : ℤ) v ≠ 0 ∧ A02.commutator (sugawaraHamiltonian h M) (Ch09.rho h (n : ℤ)) v ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_cutoff_budget.text: lemma sugawara_cutoff_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (K M : ℕ) (hM : K ≤ M) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : sugawaraHamiltonian h M v = sugawaraHamiltonian h K v

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_cutoff_independen.text: lemma sugawara_cutoff_independent (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (K M M' : ℕ) (hM : K ≤ M) (hM' : K ≤ M') (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : sugawaraHamiltonian h M v = sugawaraHamiltonian h M' v

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_equivalence.text: theorem sugawara_equivalence (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K M : ℕ) (hM : K ≤ M) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : Ch07.excitationObservable h v = sugawaraHamiltonian h M v

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_excited_witness.text: lemma sugawara_excited_witness (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (K M m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmK : m ≤ K) (hM : K ≤ M) (hR2 : 2*K ≤ h) : ∃ v : FockSpace h, v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h 0 (K : ℤ) ∧ v ≠ 0 ∧ sugawaraHamiltonian h M v = (m : ℂ) • v ∧ sugawaraHamiltonian h M v ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_ground.text: lemma sugawara_ground (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (M : ℕ) : sugawaraHamiltonian h M (Ch07.groundKet h N hN) = 0

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_inner.text: lemma sugawara_inner (h M : ℕ) (v : FockSpace h) : inner ℂ v (sugawaraHamiltonian h M v) = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, inner ℂ (Ch09.rho h (-(m : ℤ)) v) (Ch09.rho h (-(m : ℤ)) v)

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_partition_eigenva.text: lemma sugawara_partition_eigenvalue (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K M E : ℕ) (hEK : E ≤ K) (hM : K ≤ M) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) (p : Nat.Partition E) : sugawaraHamiltonian h M (Ch11.partitionState h N hN p) = (E : ℂ) • Ch11.partitionState h N hN p

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_raising_commutato.text: theorem sugawara_raising_commutator (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K M n : ℕ) (hM : K+n ≤ M) (hR2 : 2*((K+n : ℕ) : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : A02.commutator (sugawaraHamiltonian h M) (Ch09.rho h (n : ℤ)) v = (n : ℂ) • Ch09.rho h (n : ℤ) v

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_relative_hamilton.text: theorem sugawara_relative_hamiltonian (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K M : ℕ) (hM : K ≤ M) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : Ch05.shiftedHamiltonian (2*h) v = (sugawaraHamiltonian h M + ((N : ℂ)*((N : ℂ)+1)/2) • 1) v

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_signed_commutator.text: theorem sugawara_signed_commutator (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K J M : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (hshift : (K : ℤ)+n ≤ (J : ℤ)) (hMK : K ≤ M) (hMJ : J ≤ M) (hsource : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) (htarget : 2*(J : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) (v : FockSpace h) (hv : v ∈ Ch07.fixedBudget h N (K : ℤ)) : A02.commutator (sugawaraHamiltonian h M) (Ch09.rho h n) v = (n : ℂ) • Ch09.rho h n v

Bosonize.Ch12.sugawara_word_eigenvalue.text: lemma sugawara_word_eigenvalue (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : Ch07.admissible h N) (K M : ℕ) (hM : K ≤ M) (parts : List ℕ) (hE : parts.sum ≤ K) (hR2 : 2*(K : ℤ)+|N| ≤ (h : ℤ)) : sugawaraHamiltonian h M (Ch11.wordState h N hN parts) = (parts.sum : ℂ) • Ch11.wordState h N hN parts

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A05.Mode
commands.text: abbrev Mode (σ : Type*) (h : ℕ) := σ × Ch01.Band (2*h)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.speciesOrder
commands.text:
@[instance_reducible] noncomputable def speciesOrder (h : ℕ) : LinearOrder (Mode σ h) :=
  inferInstanceAs (LinearOrder (σ ×ₗ Ch01.Band (2*h)))

commands.label: instance Bosonize.A05.localModeLinearOrder
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeLinearOrder (h : ℕ) : LinearOrder (Mode σ h) := speciesOrder h

commands.label: instance Bosonize.A05.localModeLT
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeLT (h : ℕ) : LT (Mode σ h) := (speciesOrder h).toLT

commands.label: instance Bosonize.A05.localModeLE
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeLE (h : ℕ) : LE (Mode σ h) := (speciesOrder h).toLE

commands.label: instance Bosonize.A05.localModeDecidableEq
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeDecidableEq (h : ℕ) : DecidableEq (Mode σ h) := (speciesOrder h).toDecidableEq

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A05.Occupation
commands.text: abbrev Occupation (σ : Type*) [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h : ℕ) := A02.Occupation (Mode σ h)

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A05.FockSpace
commands.text: abbrev FockSpace (σ : Type*) [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h : ℕ) := A02.FockSpace (Mode σ h)

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A05.Operators
commands.text: abbrev Operators (σ : Type*) [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h : ℕ) := Module.End ℂ (FockSpace σ h)

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A05.jointBudget
commands.text: noncomputable abbrev jointBudget (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) := Ch07.speciesBudget h Ns (K : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.admissible
commands.text: def admissible (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : Prop := ∀ ν, Ch07.admissible h (Ns ν)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.r2
commands.text: def r2 (h K : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : Prop := ∀ ν, 2*(K : ℤ)+|Ns ν| ≤ (h : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.jointConfiguration
commands.text:
noncomputable def jointConfiguration (h : ℕ) (Ss : σ → Ch07.Occupation h) : Occupation σ h :=
  Finset.univ.biUnion (fun ν => (Ss ν).image (fun k => (ν,k)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.groundConfiguration
commands.text:
noncomputable def groundConfiguration (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : Occupation σ h :=
  jointConfiguration h (fun ν => Ch07.groundConfiguration h (Ns ν))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.groundKet
commands.text:
noncomputable def groundKet (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : FockSpace σ h :=
  A02.ket (groundConfiguration h Ns)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.tensorVector
commands.text:
noncomputable def tensorVector (h : ℕ) (vs : σ → Ch07.FockSpace h) : FockSpace σ h :=
  (A02.coordinates (Mode σ h)).symm (fun S => ∏ ν, vs ν (Ch07.speciesConfiguration h S ν))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.annihilation
commands.text:
noncomputable def annihilation (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) : Operators σ h :=
  Ch04.annihilation (ν,k)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.creation
commands.text:
noncomputable def creation (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) : Operators σ h :=
  Ch04.creation (ν,k)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.rho
commands.text:
noncomputable def rho (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (m : ℤ) : Operators σ h :=
  ∑ z ∈ A04.validPairs (2*h) m, Ch04.hopping (ν,z.1) (ν,z.2)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.chargeObservable
commands.text:
noncomputable def chargeObservable (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) : Operators σ h :=
  A03.diagonal (fun S => (Ch07.relativeCharge h (Ch07.speciesConfiguration h S ν) : ℂ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.creatorWord
commands.text:
noncomputable def creatorWord (h : ℕ) (parts : σ → List ℕ) : Operators σ h :=
  ((Finset.univ : Finset σ).sort (· ≤ ·)).map
    (fun ν => ((parts ν).map (fun m => rho h ν (m : ℤ))).prod) |>.prod

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.wordState
commands.text:
noncomputable def wordState (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (parts : σ → List ℕ) : FockSpace σ h :=
  creatorWord h parts (groundKet h Ns)

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A05.JointPartitions
commands.text:
abbrev JointPartitions (σ : Type*) [Fintype σ] (K : ℕ) :=
  {ps : σ → Ch11.BudgetPartitions K // ∑ ν, (ps ν).1.val ≤ K}

commands.label: instance Bosonize.A05.jointPartitionsFintype
commands.text:
noncomputable instance jointPartitionsFintype (K : ℕ) : Fintype (JointPartitions σ K) :=
  Fintype.ofFinite _

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.jointEnergy
commands.text: def jointEnergy {K : ℕ} (p : JointPartitions σ K) : ℕ := ∑ ν, (p.val ν).1.val

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.jointNormalization
commands.text:
def jointNormalization {K : ℕ} (p : JointPartitions σ K) : ℕ :=
  ∏ ν, Ch11.partitionNormalization (p.val ν).2

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05.partitionState
def Bosonize.A05.liftedAnnihilation
commands.text:
noncomputable def liftedAnnihilation (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h))
    (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : Operators σ h :=
  (A01.normalization (2*h) : ℂ) •
    ∑ k : Ch01.Band (2*h), Ch06Ext.twistedCharacter (2*h) (b ν) k x • annihilation h ν k

Bosonize.A05.annihilation_car.text: lemma annihilation_car (h : ℕ) (i j : Mode σ h) : A02.anticommutator (annihilation h i.1 i.2) (annihilation h j.1 j.2) = 0

Bosonize.A05.charge_budget.text: lemma charge_budget (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ jointBudget h Ns K) : chargeObservable h ν v = (Ns ν : ℂ) • v

Bosonize.A05.creation_adjoint.text: lemma creation_adjoint (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) : LinearMap.adjoint (annihilation h ν k) = creation h ν k

Bosonize.A05.creation_car.text: lemma creation_car (h : ℕ) (i j : Mode σ h) : A02.anticommutator (creation h i.1 i.2) (creation h j.1 j.2) = 0

Bosonize.A05.ground_mem_budget.text: lemma ground_mem_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : admissible h Ns) (K : ℕ) : groundKet h Ns ∈ jointBudget h Ns K

Bosonize.A05.ground_ne_zero.text: lemma ground_ne_zero (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : groundKet h Ns ≠ 0

Bosonize.A05.hopping_tensor.text: lemma hopping_tensor (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (p k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (vs : σ → Ch07.FockSpace h) : Ch04.hopping (ν,p) (ν,k) (tensorVector h vs) = tensorVector h (Function.update vs ν (Ch04.hopping p k (vs ν)))

Bosonize.A05.joint_normalization_positiv.text: omit [LinearOrder σ] in lemma joint_normalization_positive (K : ℕ) (p : JointPartitions σ K) : 0 < jointNormalization p

Bosonize.A05.joint_species_configuration.text: lemma joint_species_configuration (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation σ h) : jointConfiguration h (fun ν => Ch07.speciesConfiguration h S ν) = S

Bosonize.A05.mixed_car.text: lemma mixed_car (h : ℕ) (i j : Mode σ h) : A02.anticommutator (annihilation h i.1 i.2) (creation h j.1 j.2) = (if i=j then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Operators σ h)

Bosonize.A05.mode_lt_iff.text: omit [Fintype σ] in lemma mode_lt_iff (h : ℕ) (ν η : σ) (k l : Ch01.Band (2*h)) : (ν,k) < (η,l) ↔ ν < η ∨ ν=η ∧ k<l

Bosonize.A05.partition_basis.text: lemma partition_basis (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : admissible h Ns) (K : ℕ) (hR2 : r2 h K Ns) : ∃ b : Module.Basis (JointPartitions σ K) ℂ (jointBudget h Ns K), ∀ p, (b p : FockSpace σ h) = partitionState h Ns p

Bosonize.A05.partition_gram.text: lemma partition_gram (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : admissible h Ns) (K : ℕ) (hR2 : r2 h K Ns) (p q : JointPartitions σ K) : inner ℂ (partitionState h Ns p) (partitionState h Ns q) = if p=q then (jointNormalization p : ℂ) else 0

Bosonize.A05.partition_mem_budget.text: lemma partition_mem_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : admissible h Ns) (K : ℕ) (p : JointPartitions σ K) : partitionState h Ns p ∈ jointBudget h Ns K

Bosonize.A05.partition_ne_zero.text: lemma partition_ne_zero (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : admissible h Ns) (K : ℕ) (hR2 : r2 h K Ns) (p : JointPartitions σ K) : partitionState h Ns p ≠ 0

Bosonize.A05.partition_spanning.text: lemma partition_spanning (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : admissible h Ns) (K : ℕ) (hR2 : r2 h K Ns) : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (partitionState h Ns (K := K))) = jointBudget h Ns K

Bosonize.A05.preceding_count_split.text: lemma preceding_count_split (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (S : Occupation σ h) : Ch04.precedingCount (ν,k) S = (∑ η ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < ν), (Ch07.speciesConfiguration h S η).card) + Ch04.precedingCount k (Ch07.speciesConfiguration h S ν)

Bosonize.A05.rho_adjoint.text: lemma rho_adjoint (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (m : ℤ) : LinearMap.adjoint (rho h ν m) = rho h ν (-m)

Bosonize.A05.rho_budget_map.text: lemma rho_budget_map (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (m : ℤ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ jointBudget h Ns K) : rho h ν m v ∈ Ch07.speciesBudget h Ns ((K : ℤ)+m)

Bosonize.A05.rho_cross_commute.text: lemma rho_cross_commute (h : ℕ) (ν η : σ) (hne : ν ≠ η) (m n : ℤ) : A02.commutator (rho h ν m) (rho h η n) = 0

Bosonize.A05.rho_lowering_budget_zero.text: lemma rho_lowering_budget_zero (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (ν : σ) (m K : ℕ) (hm : K < m) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ jointBudget h Ns K) : rho h ν (-(m : ℤ)) v = 0

Bosonize.A05.rho_positive_commute.text: lemma rho_positive_commute (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (m n : ℕ) : A02.commutator (rho h ν (m : ℤ)) (rho h ν (n : ℤ)) = 0

Bosonize.A05.rho_tensor.text: lemma rho_tensor (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (m : ℤ) (vs : σ → Ch07.FockSpace h) : rho h ν m (tensorVector h vs) = tensorVector h (Function.update vs ν (Ch09.rho h m (vs ν)))

Bosonize.A05.species_joint_configuration.text: lemma species_joint_configuration (h : ℕ) (Ss : σ → Ch07.Occupation h) (ν : σ) : Ch07.speciesConfiguration h (jointConfiguration h Ss) ν = Ss ν

Bosonize.A05.tensor_inner.text: lemma tensor_inner (h : ℕ) (vs ws : σ → Ch07.FockSpace h) : inner ℂ (tensorVector h vs) (tensorVector h ws) = ∏ ν, inner ℂ (vs ν) (ws ν)

Bosonize.A05.tensor_kets.text: lemma tensor_kets (h : ℕ) (Ss : σ → Ch07.Occupation h) : tensorVector h (fun ν => A02.ket (Ss ν)) = A02.ket (jointConfiguration h Ss)

Bosonize.A05.word_mem_budget.text: lemma word_mem_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : admissible h Ns) (parts : σ → List ℕ) (K : ℕ) (hE : ∑ ν, (parts ν).sum ≤ K) : wordState h Ns parts ∈ jointBudget h Ns K

Bosonize.A05.word_tensor.text: lemma word_tensor (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : admissible h Ns) (parts : σ → List ℕ) : wordState h Ns parts = tensorVector h (fun ν => Ch11.wordState h (Ns ν) (hN ν) (parts ν))

commands.label: instance Bosonize.Ch13.localModeLinearOrder
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeLinearOrder (h : ℕ) : LinearOrder (A05.Mode σ h) := A05.speciesOrder h

commands.label: instance Bosonize.Ch13.localModeLT
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeLT (h : ℕ) : LT (A05.Mode σ h) := (A05.speciesOrder h).toLT

commands.label: instance Bosonize.Ch13.localModeLE
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeLE (h : ℕ) : LE (A05.Mode σ h) := (A05.speciesOrder h).toLE

commands.label: instance Bosonize.Ch13.localModeDecidableEq
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeDecidableEq (h : ℕ) : DecidableEq (A05.Mode σ h) := (A05.speciesOrder h).toDecidableEq

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch13.FockSpace
commands.text: abbrev FockSpace (σ : Type*) [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h : ℕ) := A05.FockSpace σ h

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch13.Operators
commands.text: abbrev Operators (σ : Type*) [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h : ℕ) := A05.Operators σ h

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch13.lowerCharge
commands.text: def lowerCharge (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : σ → ℤ := Function.update Ns ν (Ns ν-1)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch13.phaseExponent
commands.text:
def phaseExponent (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : ℤ :=
  (∑ η ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < ν), ((h : ℤ)+Ns η)) + ((h : ℤ)+Ns ν-1)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch13.kleinPhase
commands.text:
noncomputable def kleinPhase (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : ℂ :=
  (-1 : ℂ) ^ phaseExponent h Ns ν

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch13.pairMargin
commands.text:
def pairMargin (h K : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : Prop :=
  A05.r2 h K Ns ∧ A05.r2 h K (lowerCharge Ns ν)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch13.fourSectorMargin
def Bosonize.Ch13.kleinKernel
commands.text:
noncomputable def kleinKernel (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) : Operators σ h :=
  ∑ p : A05.JointPartitions σ K,
    (kleinPhase h Ns ν / (A05.jointNormalization p : ℂ)) •
      ((innerₛₗ ℂ (A05.partitionState h Ns p)).smulRight
        (A05.partitionState h (lowerCharge Ns ν) p))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch13.inverseKernel
commands.text:
noncomputable def inverseKernel (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) : Operators σ h :=
  ∑ p : A05.JointPartitions σ K,
    (star (kleinPhase h Ns ν) / (A05.jointNormalization p : ℂ)) •
      ((innerₛₗ ℂ (A05.partitionState h (lowerCharge Ns ν) p)).smulRight
        (A05.partitionState h Ns p))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch13.kleinFromBudget
commands.text:
noncomputable def kleinFromBudget (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) :
    A05.jointBudget h Ns K →ₗ[ℂ] FockSpace σ h :=
  (kleinKernel h Ns ν K).comp (A05.jointBudget h Ns K).subtype

Bosonize.Ch13.double_kernel_ground_nonze.text: lemma double_kernel_ground_nonzero (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν η : σ) (K : ℕ) (hm : fourSectorMargin h K Ns ν η) : kleinKernel h (lowerCharge Ns ν) η K (kleinKernel h Ns ν K (A05.groundKet h Ns)) ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch13.ground_field_coefficient.text: lemma ground_field_coefficient (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (ν : σ) (hν : -(h : ℤ)+1 ≤ Ns ν) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (x : ℤ) : inner ℂ (A05.groundKet h (lowerCharge Ns ν)) (A05.liftedAnnihilation h b ν x (A05.groundKet h Ns)) = (A01.normalization (2*h) : ℂ) * kleinPhase h Ns ν * Ch06Ext.liftPhase (2*h) (b ν) x * A01.canonicalRoot (2*h)^(x*Ns ν)

Bosonize.Ch13.ground_top_annihilation.text: lemma ground_top_annihilation (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (ν : σ) (hν : -(h : ℤ)+1 ≤ Ns ν) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (hk : k.val=Ns ν) : A05.annihilation h ν k (A05.groundKet h Ns) = kleinPhase h Ns ν • A05.groundKet h (lowerCharge Ns ν)

Bosonize.Ch13.inverse_kernel_source.text: lemma inverse_kernel_source (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hm : pairMargin h K Ns ν) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : inverseKernel h Ns ν K (kleinKernel h Ns ν K v) = v

Bosonize.Ch13.inverse_maps_budget.text: lemma inverse_maps_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (v : FockSpace σ h) : inverseKernel h Ns ν K v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K

Bosonize.Ch13.inverse_partition.text: lemma inverse_partition (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hR2 : A05.r2 h K (lowerCharge Ns ν)) (p : A05.JointPartitions σ K) : inverseKernel h Ns ν K (A05.partitionState h (lowerCharge Ns ν) p) = star (kleinPhase h Ns ν) • A05.partitionState h Ns p

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_adjoint.text: lemma kernel_adjoint (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) : LinearMap.adjoint (kleinKernel h Ns ν K) = inverseKernel h Ns ν K

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_cross_anticommute.text: lemma kernel_cross_anticommute (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν η : σ) (hne : ν≠η) (K : ℕ) (hm : fourSectorMargin h K Ns ν η) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : kleinKernel h (lowerCharge Ns ν) η K (kleinKernel h Ns ν K v) + kleinKernel h (lowerCharge Ns η) ν K (kleinKernel h Ns η K v) = 0

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_cutoff_consistent.text: lemma kernel_cutoff_consistent (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K J : ℕ) (hKJ : K≤J) (hm : pairMargin h J Ns ν) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : kleinKernel h Ns ν J v = kleinKernel h Ns ν K v

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_ground.text: lemma kernel_ground (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hm : pairMargin h K Ns ν) : kleinKernel h Ns ν K (A05.groundKet h Ns) = kleinPhase h Ns ν • A05.groundKet h (lowerCharge Ns ν)

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_ground_nonzero.text: lemma kernel_ground_nonzero (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hm : pairMargin h K Ns ν) : kleinKernel h Ns ν K (A05.groundKet h Ns) ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_inner_budget.text: lemma kernel_inner_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hm : pairMargin h K Ns ν) (v w : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) (hw : w ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : inner ℂ (kleinKernel h Ns ν K v) (kleinKernel h Ns ν K w) = inner ℂ v w

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_inverse_target.text: lemma kernel_inverse_target (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hm : pairMargin h K Ns ν) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) K) : kleinKernel h Ns ν K (inverseKernel h Ns ν K v) = v

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_lowering_intertwine.text: lemma kernel_lowering_intertwine (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν η : σ) (K m : ℕ) (hmpos : 0<m) (hm : pairMargin h (K+m) Ns ν) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns (K+m)) : kleinKernel h Ns ν K (A05.rho h η (-(m : ℤ)) v) = A05.rho h η (-(m : ℤ)) (kleinKernel h Ns ν (K+m) v)

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_maps_budget.text: lemma kernel_maps_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hN : A05.admissible h (lowerCharge Ns ν)) (v : FockSpace σ h) : kleinKernel h Ns ν K v ∈ A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) K

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_number_shift.text: lemma kernel_number_shift (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν η : σ) (K : ℕ) (hm : pairMargin h K Ns ν) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : kleinKernel h Ns ν K (A05.chargeObservable h η v) = A05.chargeObservable h η (kleinKernel h Ns ν K v) + (if ν=η then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • kleinKernel h Ns ν K v

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_partition.text: lemma kernel_partition (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hR2 : A05.r2 h K Ns) (p : A05.JointPartitions σ K) : kleinKernel h Ns ν K (A05.partitionState h Ns p) = kleinPhase h Ns ν • A05.partitionState h (lowerCharge Ns ν) p

Bosonize.Ch13.kernel_raising_intertwine.text: lemma kernel_raising_intertwine (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν η : σ) (K m : ℕ) (hmpos : 0<m) (hm : pairMargin h (K+m) Ns ν) (v : FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : kleinKernel h Ns ν (K+m) (A05.rho h η (m : ℤ) v) = A05.rho h η (m : ℤ) (kleinKernel h Ns ν K v)

Bosonize.Ch13.klein_isometry_equiv.text: theorem klein_isometry_equiv (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (K : ℕ) (hm : pairMargin h K Ns ν) : ∃ F : A05.jointBudget h Ns K ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) K, ∀ v, (F v : FockSpace σ h) = kleinKernel h Ns ν K v

Bosonize.Ch13.klein_lowering_square.text: theorem klein_lowering_square (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν η : σ) (K m : ℕ) (hmpos : 0<m) (hm : pairMargin h (K+m) Ns ν) : ∃ F0 : A05.jointBudget h Ns K ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) K, ∃ F1 : A05.jointBudget h Ns (K+m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) (K+m), ∃ R0 : A05.jointBudget h Ns (K+m) →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h Ns K, ∃ R1 : A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) (K+m) →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) K, (∀ v, (F0 v : FockSpace σ h)=kleinKernel h Ns ν K v) ∧ (∀ v, (F1 v : FockSpace σ h)=kleinKernel h Ns ν (K+m) v) ∧ (∀ v, (R0 v : FockSpace σ h)=A05.rho h η (-(m : ℤ)) v) ∧ (∀ v, (R1 v : FockSpace σ h)=A05.rho h η (-(m : ℤ)) v) ∧ F0.toLinearMap.comp R0 = R1.comp F1.toLinearMap

Bosonize.Ch13.klein_raising_square.text: theorem klein_raising_square (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν η : σ) (K m : ℕ) (hmpos : 0<m) (hm : pairMargin h (K+m) Ns ν) : ∃ F0 : A05.jointBudget h Ns K ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) K, ∃ F1 : A05.jointBudget h Ns (K+m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) (K+m), ∃ R0 : A05.jointBudget h Ns K →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h Ns (K+m), ∃ R1 : A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) K →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (lowerCharge Ns ν) (K+m), (∀ v, (F0 v : FockSpace σ h)=kleinKernel h Ns ν K v) ∧ (∀ v, (F1 v : FockSpace σ h)=kleinKernel h Ns ν (K+m) v) ∧ (∀ v, (R0 v : FockSpace σ h)=A05.rho h η (m : ℤ) v) ∧ (∀ v, (R1 v : FockSpace σ h)=A05.rho h η (m : ℤ) v) ∧ F1.toLinearMap.comp R0 = R1.comp F0.toLinearMap

Bosonize.Ch13.lower_charge_commute.text: omit [Fintype σ] in lemma lower_charge_commute (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν η : σ) (hne : ν≠η) : lowerCharge (lowerCharge Ns ν) η = lowerCharge (lowerCharge Ns η) ν

Bosonize.Ch13.phase_cross_sign.text: lemma phase_cross_sign (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν η : σ) (hne : ν≠η) : kleinPhase h (lowerCharge Ns ν) η * kleinPhase h Ns ν = -(kleinPhase h (lowerCharge Ns η) ν * kleinPhase h Ns η)

Bosonize.Ch13.phase_norm.text: lemma phase_norm (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : ‖kleinPhase h Ns ν‖ = 1

Bosonize.Ch13.r2_admissible.text: omit [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] in lemma r2_admissible (h K : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hR2 : A05.r2 h K Ns) : A05.admissible h Ns

commands.label: def Bosonize.A05Exp.finiteTaylor
commands.text:
noncomputable def finiteTaylor {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ((j.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • A ^ j

Bosonize.A05Exp.filtration_nilpotent.text: theorem filtration_nilpotent {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) (F : ℕ → Submodule ℂ V) (hbottom : F 0 = ⊥) (htop : F (d + 1) = ⊤) (hlower : ∀ n ≤ d, ∀ v ∈ F (n + 1), A v ∈ F n) : A ^ (d + 1) = 0

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_adjoint.text: theorem finite_taylor_adjoint {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) : LinearMap.adjoint (finiteTaylor d A) = finiteTaylor d (LinearMap.adjoint A)

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_apply.text: theorem finite_taylor_apply {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : finiteTaylor d A v = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ((j.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • (A ^ j) v

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_commute.text: theorem finite_taylor_commute {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) : Commute A (finiteTaylor d A)

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_cutoff.text: theorem finite_taylor_cutoff {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d e : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) (hnil : A ^ (d + 1) = 0) (hde : d ≤ e) : finiteTaylor e A = finiteTaylor d A

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_injective.text: theorem finite_taylor_injective {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) (hnil : A ^ (d + 1) = 0) : Function.Injective (finiteTaylor d A)

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_intertwine.text: theorem finite_taylor_intertwine {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) (B : Module.End ℂ W) (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) (hT : T.comp A = B.comp T) : T.comp (finiteTaylor d A) = (finiteTaylor d B).comp T

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_mul_neg.text: theorem finite_taylor_mul_neg {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) (hnil : A ^ (d + 1) = 0) : finiteTaylor d A * finiteTaylor d (-A) = 1

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_ne_zero.text: theorem finite_taylor_ne_zero {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) (hnil : A ^ (d + 1) = 0) (v : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) : finiteTaylor d A v ≠ 0

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_neg_mul.text: theorem finite_taylor_neg_mul {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) (hnil : A ^ (d + 1) = 0) : finiteTaylor d (-A) * finiteTaylor d A = 1

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_surjective.text: theorem finite_taylor_surjective {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℂ V) (hnil : A ^ (d + 1) = 0) : Function.Surjective (finiteTaylor d A)

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_zero_cutof.text: theorem finite_taylor_zero_cutoff {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (A : Module.End ℂ V) : finiteTaylor 0 A = 1

Bosonize.A05Exp.finite_taylor_zero_opera.text: theorem finite_taylor_zero_operator {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (d : ℕ) : finiteTaylor d (0 : Module.End ℂ V) = 1

commands.label: variable {R V W I : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommG
commands.text:
variable {R V W I : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W]
  [Module R V] [Module R W]

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.creatorWord
commands.text:
def creatorWord (G : I → Module.End R V) (is : List I) : Module.End R V :=
  (is.map G).prod

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.cyclicSpan
commands.text:
def cyclicSpan (G : I → Module.End R V) (v₀ : V) : Submodule R V :=
  Submodule.span R (Set.range (fun is : List I => creatorWord G is v₀))

commands.label: instance Bosonize.Ch14.localModeLinearOrder
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeLinearOrder (h : ℕ) : LinearOrder (A05.Mode σ h) := A05.speciesOrder h

commands.label: instance Bosonize.Ch14.localModeLT
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeLT (h : ℕ) : LT (A05.Mode σ h) := (A05.speciesOrder h).toLT

commands.label: instance Bosonize.Ch14.localModeLE
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeLE (h : ℕ) : LE (A05.Mode σ h) := (A05.speciesOrder h).toLE

commands.label: instance Bosonize.Ch14.localModeDecidableEq
commands.text: noncomputable local instance localModeDecidableEq (h : ℕ) : DecidableEq (A05.Mode σ h) := (A05.speciesOrder h).toDecidableEq

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.budgetSet
def Bosonize.Ch14.projection
commands.text:
noncomputable def projection (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  A03.coordinateProjection (budgetSet h Ns K)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.projectedMap
commands.text:
noncomputable def projectedMap (h : ℕ) (Ns Nt : σ → ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ)
    (A : A05.Operators σ h) : A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h Nt Kout :=
  (projection h Nt Kout * A).domRestrict (A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin) |>.codRestrict
    (A05.jointBudget h Nt Kout) (fun v => by
      change projection h Nt Kout (A v.val) ∈ A03.coordinateSpace (budgetSet h Nt Kout)
      rw [← A03.projection_range]
      exact ⟨A v.val, rfl⟩)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.budgetAdjoint
commands.text:
noncomputable def budgetAdjoint (h : ℕ) (Ns Nt : σ → ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ)
    (A : A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h Nt Kout) :
    A05.jointBudget h Nt Kout →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin :=
  LinearMap.adjoint (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin) (F := A05.jointBudget h Nt Kout) A

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.groundVector
commands.text:
noncomputable def groundVector (h : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (Ns : σ → ℤ)
    (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (K : ℕ) : A05.jointBudget h Ns K :=
  ⟨A05.groundKet h Ns, A05.ground_mem_budget h hh Ns hN K⟩

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.wPlus
commands.text:
noncomputable def wPlus (h M : ℕ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, (A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot (2*h)) ((m+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) x /
    (m+1 : ℂ)) • A05.rho h ν (-((m+1 : ℕ) : ℤ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.wMinus
commands.text:
noncomputable def wMinus (h M : ℕ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  -∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, (A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot (2*h)) (-((m+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) x /
    (m+1 : ℂ)) • A05.rho h ν ((m+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.compressedPlus
commands.text:
noncomputable def compressedPlus (h M : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  projection h Ns K * wPlus h M ν x * projection h Ns K

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.compressedMinus
commands.text:
noncomputable def compressedMinus (h M : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  projection h Ns K * wMinus h M ν x * projection h Ns K

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.zeroScalar
commands.text:
noncomputable def zeroScalar (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h))
    (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  Ch06Ext.liftPhase (2*h) (b ν) x * A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot (2*h)) (Ns ν) x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.zeroMode
commands.text:
noncomputable def zeroMode (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h))
    (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (K : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ (A05.jointBudget h Ns K) :=
  zeroScalar h b Ns ν x • LinearMap.id

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.physicalMap
commands.text:
noncomputable def physicalMap (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h))
    (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) :
    A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν) Kout :=
  projectedMap h Ns (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν) Kin Kout (A05.liftedAnnihilation h b ν x)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch14.vertexCandidate
commands.text:
noncomputable def vertexCandidate (h M : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h))
    (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) :
    A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν) Kout :=
  let Nt := Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν
  (A01.normalization (2*h) : ℂ) •
    (A05Exp.finiteTaylor Kout (projectedMap h Nt Nt Kout Kout (wMinus h M ν x))).comp
      ((projectedMap h Nt Nt Kin Kout LinearMap.id).comp
        ((A05Exp.finiteTaylor Kin (projectedMap h Nt Nt Kin Kin (wPlus h M ν x))).comp
          ((projectedMap h Ns Nt Kin Kin (Ch13.kleinKernel h Ns ν Kin)).comp
            (zeroMode h b Ns ν x Kin))))

Bosonize.Ch14.compressed_minus_nilpotent.text: lemma compressed_minus_nilpotent (h M : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : compressedMinus h M Ns K ν x ^ (K+1) = 0

Bosonize.Ch14.compressed_plus_nilpotent.text: lemma compressed_plus_nilpotent (h M : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : compressedPlus h M Ns K ν x ^ (K+1) = 0

Bosonize.Ch14.cyclic_common_residual.text: theorem cyclic_common_residual (G : I → Module.End R V) (T : I → Module.End R W) (A B : V →ₗ[R] W) (residual : I → V →ₗ[R] W) (v₀ : V) (hcyclic : cyclicSpan G v₀ = ⊤) (hground : A v₀ = B v₀) (hA : ∀ i, A.comp (G i) = (T i).comp A + residual i) (hB : ∀ i, B.comp (G i) = (T i).comp B + residual i) : A = B

Bosonize.Ch14.field_vertex_of_common_res.text: theorem field_vertex_of_common_residual (h M : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) {I : Type*} (G : I → Module.End ℂ (A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin)) (T : I → Module.End ℂ (A05.jointBudget h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν) Kout)) (residual : I → A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin →ₗ[ℂ] A05.jointBudget h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν) Kout) (v₀ : A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin) (hcyclic : cyclicSpan G v₀ = ⊤) (hground : physicalMap h b Ns ν x Kin Kout v₀ = vertexCandidate h M b Ns ν x Kin Kout v₀) (hA : ∀ i, (physicalMap h b Ns ν x Kin Kout).comp (G i) = (T i).comp (physicalMap h b Ns ν x Kin Kout) + residual i) (hB : ∀ i, (vertexCandidate h M b Ns ν x Kin Kout).comp (G i) = (T i).comp (vertexCandidate h M b Ns ν x Kin Kout) + residual i) : physicalMap h b Ns ν x Kin Kout = vertexCandidate h M b Ns ν x Kin Kout

Bosonize.Ch14.klein_zero_ground.text: lemma klein_zero_ground (h : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (K : ℕ) (hm : Ch13.pairMargin h K Ns ν) : Ch13.kleinKernel h Ns ν K (zeroScalar h b Ns ν x • A05.groundKet h Ns) = (zeroScalar h b Ns ν x * Ch13.kleinPhase h Ns ν) • A05.groundKet h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν)

Bosonize.Ch14.physical_ground_expansion.text: lemma physical_ground_expansion (h : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) : (physicalMap h b Ns ν x Kin Kout (groundVector h hh Ns hN Kin) : A05.FockSpace σ h) = (A01.normalization (2*h) : ℂ) • ∑ k : Ch01.Band (2*h), if (ν,k) ∈ A05.groundConfiguration h Ns then (Ch06Ext.twistedCharacter (2*h) (b ν) k x * Ch04.fermionSign (ν,k) (A05.groundConfiguration h Ns)) • projection h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν) Kout (A02.ket ((A05.groundConfiguration h Ns).erase (ν,k))) else 0

Bosonize.Ch14.physical_map_winding.text: lemma physical_map_winding (h : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x w : ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) : physicalMap h b Ns ν (x+w*(2*h : ℕ)) Kin Kout = Ch06Ext.holonomy (2*h) (b ν)^w • physicalMap h b Ns ν x Kin Kout

Bosonize.Ch14.physical_occupation_expans.text: lemma physical_occupation_expansion (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (Kout : ℕ) (S : A05.Occupation σ h) : projection h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν) Kout (A05.liftedAnnihilation h b ν x (A02.ket S)) = (A01.normalization (2*h) : ℂ) • ∑ k : Ch01.Band (2*h), if (ν,k) ∈ S then (Ch06Ext.twistedCharacter (2*h) (b ν) k x * Ch04.fermionSign (ν,k) S) • projection h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν) Kout (A02.ket (S.erase (ν,k))) else 0

Bosonize.Ch14.projected_map_adjoint.text: lemma projected_map_adjoint (h : ℕ) (Ns Nt : σ → ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) (A : A05.Operators σ h) : budgetAdjoint h Ns Nt Kin Kout (projectedMap h Ns Nt Kin Kout A) = projectedMap h Nt Ns Kout Kin (LinearMap.adjoint A)

Bosonize.Ch14.projected_map_apply.text: lemma projected_map_apply (h : ℕ) (Ns Nt : σ → ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) (A : A05.Operators σ h) (v : A05.jointBudget h Ns Kin) : (projectedMap h Ns Nt Kin Kout A v : A05.FockSpace σ h) = projection h Nt Kout (A v)

Bosonize.Ch14.projected_minus_nilpotent.text: lemma projected_minus_nilpotent (h M : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : projectedMap h Ns Ns K K (wMinus h M ν x) ^ (K+1) = 0

Bosonize.Ch14.projected_plus_nilpotent.text: lemma projected_plus_nilpotent (h M : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : projectedMap h Ns Ns K K (wPlus h M ν x) ^ (K+1) = 0

Bosonize.Ch14.projected_recurrence_resid.text: lemma projected_recurrence_residual (h : ℕ) (Ns Nt : σ → ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) (c rho : A05.Operators σ h) : let Pin := projection h Ns Kin let Pout := projection h Nt Kout (Pout*c*Pin)*(Pin*rho*Pin) - (Pout*rho*Pout)*(Pout*c*Pin) = Pout*(c*rho-rho*c)*Pin - Pout*c*(1-Pin)*rho*Pin + Pout*rho*(1-Pout)*c*Pin

Bosonize.Ch14.vertex_candidate_adjoint.text: lemma vertex_candidate_adjoint (h M : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) : let Nt := Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν budgetAdjoint h Ns Nt Kin Kout (vertexCandidate h M b Ns ν x Kin Kout) = (A01.normalization (2*h) : ℂ) • (budgetAdjoint h Ns Ns Kin Kin (zeroMode h b Ns ν x Kin)).comp ((budgetAdjoint h Ns Nt Kin Kin (projectedMap h Ns Nt Kin Kin (Ch13.kleinKernel h Ns ν Kin))).comp ((budgetAdjoint h Nt Nt Kin Kin (A05Exp.finiteTaylor Kin (projectedMap h Nt Nt Kin Kin (wPlus h M ν x)))).comp ((budgetAdjoint h Nt Nt Kin Kout (projectedMap h Nt Nt Kin Kout LinearMap.id)).comp (budgetAdjoint h Nt Nt Kout Kout (A05Exp.finiteTaylor Kout (projectedMap h Nt Nt Kout Kout (wMinus h M ν x)))))))

Bosonize.Ch14.vertex_candidate_winding.text: lemma vertex_candidate_winding (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x w : ℤ) (Kin Kout : ℕ) : vertexCandidate h M b Ns ν (x+w*(2*h : ℕ)) Kin Kout = Ch06Ext.holonomy (2*h) (b ν)^w • vertexCandidate h M b Ns ν x Kin Kout

Bosonize.Ch14.w_minus_adjoint.text: lemma w_minus_adjoint (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : LinearMap.adjoint (wMinus h M ν x) = -wPlus h M ν x

Bosonize.Ch14.w_minus_periodic.text: lemma w_minus_periodic (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (ν : σ) (x w : ℤ) : wMinus h M ν (x+w*(2*h : ℕ)) = wMinus h M ν x

Bosonize.Ch14.w_plus_adjoint.text: lemma w_plus_adjoint (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : LinearMap.adjoint (wPlus h M ν x) = -wMinus h M ν x

Bosonize.Ch14.w_plus_periodic.text: lemma w_plus_periodic (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (ν : σ) (x w : ℤ) : wPlus h M ν (x+w*(2*h : ℕ)) = wPlus h M ν x

Bosonize.Ch14.zero_mode_adjoint.text: lemma zero_mode_adjoint (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (K : ℕ) : LinearMap.adjoint (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := A05.jointBudget h Ns K) (F := A05.jointBudget h Ns K) (zeroMode h b Ns ν x K) = star (zeroScalar h b Ns ν x) • LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch14.zero_mode_unitary.text: lemma zero_mode_unitary (h : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) (K : ℕ) : LinearMap.adjoint (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := A05.jointBudget h Ns K) (F := A05.jointBudget h Ns K) (zeroMode h b Ns ν x K) * zeroMode h b Ns ν x K = 1 ∧ zeroMode h b Ns ν x K * LinearMap.adjoint (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := A05.jointBudget h Ns K) (F := A05.jointBudget h Ns K) (zeroMode h b Ns ν x K) = 1

Bosonize.Ch14.zero_mode_winding.text: lemma zero_mode_winding (h : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x w : ℤ) (K : ℕ) : zeroMode h b Ns ν (x+w*(2*h : ℕ)) K = Ch06Ext.holonomy (2*h) (b ν)^w • zeroMode h b Ns ν x K

Bosonize.Ch14.zero_scalar_norm.text: omit [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] in lemma zero_scalar_norm (h : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : ‖zeroScalar h b Ns ν x‖ = 1

Bosonize.Ch14.zero_scalar_winding.text: omit [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] in lemma zero_scalar_winding (h : ℕ) [NeZero (2*h)] (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2*h)) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (x w : ℤ) : zeroScalar h b Ns ν (x+w*(2*h : ℕ)) = Ch06Ext.holonomy (2*h) (b ν)^w * zeroScalar h b Ns ν x

commands.label: inductive Bosonize.A06.Orientation
commands.text:
inductive Orientation where
  | right
  | left
  deriving DecidableEq

commands.label: structure Bosonize.A06.Branches
commands.text:
structure Branches (σ : Type*) where
  rightSpecies : σ
  leftSpecies : σ
  distinct : rightSpecies ≠ leftSpecies

commands.label: def Bosonize.A06.speciesOf
commands.text:
def speciesOf {σ : Type*} (branches : Branches σ) : Orientation → σ
  | .right => branches.rightSpecies
  | .left => branches.leftSpecies

commands.label: def Bosonize.A06.marginAt
commands.text:
def marginAt (h M K : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : Prop :=
  2 * (M : ℤ) + (K : ℤ) + |Ns ν| ≤ (h : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A06.branchMargins
commands.text:
def branchMargins (h M K : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ)
    (branches : Branches σ) : Prop :=
  marginAt h M K Ns branches.rightSpecies ∧
    marginAt h M K Ns branches.leftSpecies

commands.label: def Bosonize.A06.latticeCharacter
commands.text:
noncomputable def latticeCharacter (h : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (k : ℤ)
    (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : ℂ :=
  A01.integerCharacter ζ k (x.val : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A06.skewKernel
commands.text:
noncomputable def skewKernel (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : ℂ :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    (latticeCharacter h ζ (m : ℤ) (x - y) -
      latticeCharacter h ζ (-(m : ℤ)) (x - y)) / (m : ℂ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A06.dirichletKernel
commands.text:
noncomputable def dirichletKernel (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : ℂ :=
  ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc (-(M : ℤ)) (M : ℤ),
      latticeCharacter h ζ m (x - y)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A06.opForwardDiff
commands.text:
def opForwardDiff (h : ℕ) {V : Type*} [AddGroup V]
    (f : ZMod (2 * h) → V) : ZMod (2 * h) → V :=
  fun x => f (x + 1) - f x

commands.label: def Bosonize.A06.integerLift
def Bosonize.A06.chiralField
commands.text:
noncomputable def chiralField (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (branches : Branches σ) (η : Orientation)
    (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    (Complex.I / (m : ℂ)) •
      ((latticeCharacter h ζ (orientationSign η * (m : ℤ)) x •
          A05.rho h (speciesOf branches η) (-(m : ℤ))) -
        (latticeCharacter h ζ (-(orientationSign η * (m : ℤ))) x •
          A05.rho h (speciesOf branches η) (m : ℤ)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A06.chiralDifferenceExpansion
commands.text:
noncomputable def chiralDifferenceExpansion (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (branches : Branches σ) (η : Orientation)
    (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    (Complex.I / (m : ℂ)) •
      (((A01.integerCharacter ζ (orientationSign η * (m : ℤ)) 1 - 1) *
          latticeCharacter h ζ (orientationSign η * (m : ℤ)) x) •
          A05.rho h (speciesOf branches η) (-(m : ℤ)) -
        ((A01.integerCharacter ζ (-(orientationSign η * (m : ℤ))) 1 - 1) *
          latticeCharacter h ζ (-(orientationSign η * (m : ℤ))) x) •
          A05.rho h (speciesOf branches η) (m : ℤ))

Bosonize.A06.admissible_ground_nonzero.text: lemma admissible_ground_nonzero (h K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) : ∃ v : A05.FockSpace σ h, v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K ∧ v ≠ 0

Bosonize.A06.chiral_adjoint.text: lemma chiral_adjoint (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : Branches σ) (η : Orientation) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : LinearMap.adjoint (chiralField h M ζ branches η x) = chiralField h M ζ branches η x

Bosonize.A06.chiral_cross_commute.text: lemma chiral_cross_commute (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (branches : Branches σ) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : A02.commutator (chiralField h M ζ branches .right x) (chiralField h M ζ branches .left y) = 0

Bosonize.A06.chiral_forward_diff.text: lemma chiral_forward_diff (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : Branches σ) (η : Orientation) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : opForwardDiff h (chiralField h M ζ branches η) x = chiralDifferenceExpansion h M ζ branches η x

Bosonize.A06.chiral_same_commutator_on_b.text: lemma chiral_same_commutator_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : Branches σ) (η : Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : marginAt h M K Ns (speciesOf branches η)) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : A02.commutator (chiralField h M ζ branches η x) (chiralField h M ζ branches η y) v = ((orientationSign η : ℂ) * skewKernel h M ζ x y) • v

Bosonize.A06.concrete_two_branch_paramet.text: lemma concrete_two_branch_parameters : ∃ (h M K : ℕ) (Ns : Fin 2 → ℤ) (branches : Branches (Fin 2)), 0 < h ∧ 1 ≤ M ∧ 2 * M < 2 * h ∧ A05.admissible h Ns ∧ branchMargins h M K Ns branches ∧ A05.groundKet h Ns ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K ∧ A05.groundKet h Ns ≠ 0

Bosonize.A06.dirichlet_diagonal.text: lemma dirichlet_diagonal (h M : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (ζ : ℂ) : dirichletKernel h M ζ (0 : ZMod (2 * h)) 0 = ((2 * M + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)

Bosonize.A06.dirichlet_spatial_sum.text: lemma dirichlet_spatial_sum (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : (∑ y : ZMod (2 * h), dirichletKernel h M ζ x y) = 1

Bosonize.A06.forward_diff_add.text: lemma forward_diff_add (h : ℕ) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] (f g : ZMod (2 * h) → V) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : opForwardDiff h (fun y => f y + g y) x = opForwardDiff h f x + opForwardDiff h g x

Bosonize.A06.forward_diff_smul.text: lemma forward_diff_smul (h : ℕ) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (a : ℂ) (f : ZMod (2 * h) → V) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : opForwardDiff h (fun y => a • f y) x = a • opForwardDiff h f x

Bosonize.A06.forward_diff_sum_zero.text: lemma forward_diff_sum_zero (h : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] (f : ZMod (2 * h) → V) : (∑ x : ZMod (2 * h), opForwardDiff h f x) = 0

Bosonize.A06.integer_lift_periodic.text: lemma integer_lift_periodic (h : ℕ) {V : Type*} (f : ZMod (2 * h) → V) (x : ℤ) : integerLift h f (x + (2 * h : ℕ)) = integerLift h f x

Bosonize.A06.joint_signed_current_commut.text: lemma joint_signed_current_commutator (h K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) (m n : ℤ) (hmargin : |m| + |n| + (K : ℤ) + |Ns ν| ≤ (h : ℤ)) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : A02.commutator (A05.rho h ν m) (A05.rho h ν n) v = Ch10.schwingerCoefficient m n • v

Bosonize.A06.lattice_character_conj.text: lemma lattice_character_conj (h : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (k : ℤ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : star (latticeCharacter h ζ k x) = latticeCharacter h ζ (-k) x

Bosonize.A06.lattice_character_shift.text: lemma lattice_character_shift (h : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (k : ℤ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : latticeCharacter h ζ k (x + 1) = A01.integerCharacter ζ k 1 * latticeCharacter h ζ k x

Bosonize.A06.skew_kernel_diff_sum_zero.text: lemma skew_kernel_diff_sum_zero (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : (∑ y : ZMod (2 * h), opForwardDiff h (skewKernel h M ζ x) y) = 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch15.phiField
commands.text:
noncomputable def phiField (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  A06.chiralField h M ζ branches .right x +
    A06.chiralField h M ζ branches .left x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch15.thetaField
commands.text:
noncomputable def thetaField (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  A06.chiralField h M ζ branches .right x -
    A06.chiralField h M ζ branches .left x

Bosonize.Ch15.mixed_commutator_on_budget.text: lemma mixed_commutator_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : A02.commutator (phiField h M ζ branches x) (thetaField h M ζ branches y) v = (2 * A06.skewKernel h M ζ x y) • v

Bosonize.Ch15.mixed_forward_diff_on_budg.text: lemma mixed_forward_diff_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : A02.commutator (phiField h M ζ branches x) (A06.opForwardDiff h (thetaField h M ζ branches) y) v = (2 * A06.opForwardDiff h (A06.skewKernel h M ζ x) y) • v

Bosonize.Ch15.phi_adjoint.text: lemma phi_adjoint (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : LinearMap.adjoint (phiField h M ζ branches x) = phiField h M ζ branches x

Bosonize.Ch15.phi_self_commutator_on_bud.text: lemma phi_self_commutator_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : A02.commutator (phiField h M ζ branches x) (phiField h M ζ branches y) v = 0

Bosonize.Ch15.theta_adjoint.text: lemma theta_adjoint (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : LinearMap.adjoint (thetaField h M ζ branches x) = thetaField h M ζ branches x

Bosonize.Ch15.theta_self_commutator_on_b.text: lemma theta_self_commutator_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : A02.commutator (thetaField h M ζ branches x) (thetaField h M ζ branches y) v = 0

Bosonize.Ch15.zero_mode_obstruction_on_g.text: theorem zero_mode_obstruction_on_ground (h M K : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) : ¬ (∀ y : ZMod (2 * h), A02.commutator (phiField h M ζ branches x) (A06.opForwardDiff h (thetaField h M ζ branches) y) (A05.groundKet h Ns) = (c * A06.dirichletKernel h M ζ x y) • A05.groundKet h Ns)

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A07.Letter
commands.text: abbrev Letter (M : ℕ) := Bool × Fin M × Bool

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A07.QuadraticSymbol
commands.text: abbrev QuadraticSymbol (M : ℕ) := (Letter M × Letter M) → ℂ

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.orientation
commands.text:
def orientation (b : Bool) : A06.Orientation :=
  if b then .left else .right

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.natMode
commands.text: def natMode {M : ℕ} (p : Letter M) : ℕ := p.2.1.val + 1

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.phaseSign
commands.text:
def phaseSign {M : ℕ} (p : Letter M) : ℤ :=
  if p.2.2 then -1 else 1

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.signedMode
commands.text:
def signedMode {M : ℕ} (p : Letter M) : ℤ :=
  if p.2.2 then (natMode p : ℤ) else -(natMode p : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.current
commands.text:
noncomputable def current (h M : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ)
    (p : Letter M) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches (orientation p.1)) (signedMode p)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.rawPair
commands.text:
noncomputable def rawPair (h M : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ)
    (p q : Letter M) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  current h M branches p * current h M branches q

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.normalPair
commands.text:
noncomputable def normalPair (h M : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ)
    (p q : Letter M) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  if p.2.2 = false ∧ q.2.2 = true then
    current h M branches q * current h M branches p
  else rawPair h M branches p q

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.rawEvaluation
commands.text:
noncomputable def rawEvaluation (h M : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ)
    (Q : QuadraticSymbol M) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ pq : Letter M × Letter M, (Q pq) •
    rawPair h M branches pq.1 pq.2

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.normalEvaluation
commands.text:
noncomputable def normalEvaluation (h M : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ)
    (Q : QuadraticSymbol M) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ pq : Letter M × Letter M, (Q pq) •
    normalPair h M branches pq.1 pq.2

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.squareSymbol
commands.text:
def squareSymbol {M : ℕ} (a : Letter M → ℂ) : QuadraticSymbol M :=
  fun pq => a pq.1 * a pq.2

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.gradientCoefficient
commands.text:
noncomputable def gradientCoefficient (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (x : ZMod (2 * h)) (p : Letter M) : ℂ :=
  let k : ℤ := phaseSign p * A06.orientationSign (orientation p.1) *
    (natMode p : ℤ)
  ((phaseSign p : ℂ) * Complex.I / (natMode p : ℂ)) *
    (A01.integerCharacter ζ k 1 - 1) *
      A06.latticeCharacter h ζ k x

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.chiralCoefficient
commands.text:
noncomputable def chiralCoefficient (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (η : A06.Orientation) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) (p : Letter M) : ℂ :=
  if orientation p.1 = η then gradientCoefficient h M ζ x p else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.phiCoefficient
commands.text:
noncomputable def phiCoefficient (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : Letter M → ℂ :=
  gradientCoefficient h M ζ x

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.thetaCoefficient
commands.text:
noncomputable def thetaCoefficient (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (x : ZMod (2 * h)) (p : Letter M) : ℂ :=
  (A06.orientationSign (orientation p.1) : ℂ) *
    gradientCoefficient h M ζ x p

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07.dualSquareSymbol
commands.text:
noncomputable def dualSquareSymbol (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : QuadraticSymbol M :=
  squareSymbol (phiCoefficient h M ζ x) +
    squareSymbol (thetaCoefficient h M ζ x)

Bosonize.A07.chiral_gradient_representat.text: lemma chiral_gradient_representation (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : (∑ p : Letter M, (chiralCoefficient h M ζ η x p) • current h M branches p) = A06.opForwardDiff h (A06.chiralField h M ζ branches η) x

Bosonize.A07.contraction_on_joint_budget.text: lemma contraction_on_joint_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (p q : Letter M) (hp : p.2.2 = false) (hq : q.2.2 = true) (hbranch : p.1 = q.1) (hmargin : A06.marginAt h M K Ns (A06.speciesOf branches (orientation p.1))) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : (normalPair h M branches p q - rawPair h M branches p q) v = (if natMode p = natMode q then -(natMode p : ℂ) else 0) • v

Bosonize.A07.dual_square_chiral_decompos.text: lemma dual_square_chiral_decomposition (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : dualSquareSymbol h M ζ x = (2 : ℂ) • (squareSymbol (chiralCoefficient h M ζ .right x) + squareSymbol (chiralCoefficient h M ζ .left x))

Bosonize.A07.normal_evaluation_add.text: lemma normal_evaluation_add (h M : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Q R : QuadraticSymbol M) : normalEvaluation h M branches (Q + R) = normalEvaluation h M branches Q + normalEvaluation h M branches R

Bosonize.A07.normal_evaluation_smul.text: lemma normal_evaluation_smul (h M : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (a : ℂ) (Q : QuadraticSymbol M) : normalEvaluation h M branches (a • Q) = a • normalEvaluation h M branches Q

Bosonize.A07.normal_pair_contraction.text: lemma normal_pair_contraction (h M : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (p q : Letter M) : normalPair h M branches p q - rawPair h M branches p q = if p.2.2 = false ∧ q.2.2 = true then A02.commutator (current h M branches q) (current h M branches p) else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.marginWithExcursion
commands.text:
def marginWithExcursion (h M K excursion : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : Prop :=
  ∀ η : A06.Orientation,
    2 * (M : ℤ) + (K : ℤ) + (excursion : ℤ) +
      |Ns (A06.speciesOf branches η)| ≤ (h : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.chiralSquare
commands.text:
noncomputable def chiralSquare (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation)
    (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  A07.normalEvaluation h M branches
    (A07.squareSymbol (A07.chiralCoefficient h M ζ η x))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.localFieldEnergy
commands.text:
noncomputable def localFieldEnergy (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ)
    (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  A07.normalEvaluation h M branches (A07.dualSquareSymbol h M ζ x)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.fieldHamiltonian
commands.text:
noncomputable def fieldHamiltonian (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)]
    (ζ : ℂ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ x : ZMod (2 * h), localFieldEnergy h M ζ branches x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.epsilon
commands.text:
noncomputable def epsilon (h : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ) / (m : ℂ) ^ 2) *
    (A01.integerCharacter ζ (m : ℤ) 1 - 1) *
      (A01.integerCharacter ζ (-(m : ℤ)) 1 - 1)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.referenceWeight
commands.text:
noncomputable def referenceWeight (h : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  epsilon h ζ 1

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.sugawara
commands.text:
noncomputable def sugawara (h M : ℕ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .right) (m : ℤ) *
      A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .right) (-(m : ℤ))) +
  (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .left) (m : ℤ) *
      A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .left) (-(m : ℤ)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.weightedEnergy
commands.text:
noncomputable def weightedEnergy (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    epsilon h ζ m •
      (A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .right) (m : ℤ) *
        A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .right) (-(m : ℤ)))) +
  (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    epsilon h ζ m •
      (A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .left) (m : ℤ) *
        A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .left) (-(m : ℤ))))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.weightedError
commands.text:
noncomputable def weightedError (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    (epsilon h ζ m - referenceWeight h ζ) •
      (A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .right) (m : ℤ) *
        A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .right) (-(m : ℤ)))) +
  (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    (epsilon h ζ m - referenceWeight h ζ) •
      (A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .left) (m : ℤ) *
        A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches .left) (-(m : ℤ))))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.errorOperator
commands.text:
noncomputable def errorOperator (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)]
    (ζ : ℂ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  fieldHamiltonian h M ζ branches -
    ((4 : ℂ) * referenceWeight h ζ) • sugawara h M branches

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch16.excitedKet
commands.text:
noncomputable def excitedKet (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation)
    (m : ℕ) : A05.FockSpace σ h :=
  A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches η) (m : ℤ) (A05.groundKet h Ns)

Bosonize.Ch16.chiral_spatial_collapse_on.text: lemma chiral_spatial_collapse_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : A06.marginAt h M K Ns (A06.speciesOf branches η)) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : (∑ x : ZMod (2 * h), chiralSquare h M ζ branches η x) v = ((2 : ℂ) • (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, epsilon h ζ m • (A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches η) (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches η) (-(m : ℤ))))) v

Bosonize.Ch16.concrete_excited_error_wit.text: theorem concrete_excited_error_witness : A05.admissible 8 (fun _ : Fin 2 => 0) ∧ A06.branchMargins 8 2 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => 0) standardBranches ∧ excitedKet 8 (fun _ : Fin 2 => 0) standardBranches .right 2 ≠ 0 ∧ errorOperator 8 2 (A01.canonicalRoot 16) standardBranches (excitedKet 8 (fun _ : Fin 2 => 0) standardBranches .right 2) ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch16.error_nonzero_witness.text: theorem error_nonzero_witness (h M K m : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) (hK : m ≤ K) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (hweight : epsilon h ζ m ≠ referenceWeight h ζ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) : excitedKet h Ns branches η m ≠ 0 ∧ errorOperator h M ζ branches (excitedKet h Ns branches η m) ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch16.error_weighted_on_budget.text: lemma error_weighted_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : errorOperator h M ζ branches v = ((4 : ℂ) • weightedError h M ζ branches) v

Bosonize.Ch16.excited_ket_mem_budget.text: lemma excited_ket_mem_budget (h K m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : m ≤ K) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) : excitedKet h Ns branches η m ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K

Bosonize.Ch16.excited_ket_nonzero.text: lemma excited_ket_nonzero (h M m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) (hmargin : A06.marginAt h M m Ns (A06.speciesOf branches η)) : excitedKet h Ns branches η m ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch16.field_chiral_identity.text: lemma field_chiral_identity (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : localFieldEnergy h M ζ branches x = (2 : ℂ) • (chiralSquare h M ζ branches .right x + chiralSquare h M ζ branches .left x)

Bosonize.Ch16.field_weighted_after_excur.text: theorem field_weighted_after_excursion (h M K excursion : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : marginWithExcursion h M K excursion Ns branches) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns (K + excursion)) : fieldHamiltonian h M ζ branches v = ((4 : ℂ) • weightedEnergy h M ζ branches) v

Bosonize.Ch16.field_weighted_on_budget.text: theorem field_weighted_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : fieldHamiltonian h M ζ branches v = ((4 : ℂ) • weightedEnergy h M ζ branches) v

Bosonize.Ch16.first_mode_error_zero.text: theorem first_mode_error_zero (h M K : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) : errorOperator h M ζ branches (excitedKet h Ns branches η 1) = 0

Bosonize.Ch16.ground_error_zero.text: lemma ground_error_zero (h M K : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) : errorOperator h M ζ branches (A05.groundKet h Ns) = 0

Bosonize.Ch16.single_mode_error_eigenvec.text: theorem single_mode_error_eigenvector (h M K m : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hNoAlias : 2 * M < 2 * h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) (hK : m ≤ K) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) : errorOperator h M ζ branches (excitedKet h Ns branches η m) = ((4 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * (epsilon h ζ m - referenceWeight h ζ)) • excitedKet h Ns branches η m

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaIndicator
commands.text:
def seaIndicator (h : ℕ) (k : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : ℂ :=
  if k.val ≤ 0 then 1 else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.creatorToSeaLetter
def Bosonize.A07Interactions.annihilatorToSeaLetter
def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaInversions
commands.text:
def seaInversions (h : ℕ) : List (Bool × Ch01.Band (2 * h)) → ℕ
  | [] => 0
  | (true, _) :: rest => seaInversions h rest
  | (false, _) :: rest => (rest.filter (fun l => l.1)).length + seaInversions h rest

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.bilinearWord
def Bosonize.A07Interactions.quarticWord
commands.text:
def quarticWord (h : ℕ) (a b c d : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) :
    List (Bool × Ch01.Band (2 * h)) :=
  [creatorToSeaLetter h a, annihilatorToSeaLetter h b,
   creatorToSeaLetter h c, annihilatorToSeaLetter h d]

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaWickWeight
structure Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams
commands.text:
structure HyperbolicParams (v1 v2 : ℝ) where
  u : ℝ
  c : ℝ
  s : ℝ
  u_pos : 0 < u
  c_pos : 0 < c
  u_sq : u ^ 2 = v1 ^ 2 - v2 ^ 2
  hyperbolic_id : c ^ 2 - s ^ 2 = 1
  match_v1 : v1 = u * (c ^ 2 + s ^ 2)
  match_v2 : v2 = 2 * u * c * s

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaQuasiAnnihilator
commands.text:
noncomputable def seaQuasiAnnihilator (h : ℕ) (ν : σ)
    (k : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  if k.val ≤ 0 then A05.creation h ν k else A05.annihilation h ν k

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaQuasiCreator
commands.text:
noncomputable def seaQuasiCreator (h : ℕ) (ν : σ)
    (k : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  if k.val ≤ 0 then A05.annihilation h ν k else A05.creation h ν k

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.evalSeaLetter
commands.text:
noncomputable def evalSeaLetter (h : ℕ) (ν : σ)
    (l : Bool × Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  if l.1 then seaQuasiCreator h ν l.2 else seaQuasiAnnihilator h ν l.2

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaWickWord
def Bosonize.A07Interactions.numberOp
commands.text:
noncomputable def numberOp (h : ℕ) (ν : σ)
    (k : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  A05.creation h ν k * A05.annihilation h ν k

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaSubtractedNumber
commands.text:
noncomputable def seaSubtractedNumber (h : ℕ) (ν : σ)
    (k : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  numberOp h ν k - seaIndicator h k • (1 : A05.Operators σ h)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaNormalBilinear
commands.text:
noncomputable def seaNormalBilinear (h : ℕ) (ν : σ)
    (a b : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  A05.creation h ν a * A05.annihilation h ν b -
    (if a = b then seaIndicator h a else 0) • (1 : A05.Operators σ h)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaNormalRho
commands.text:
noncomputable def seaNormalRho (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (m : ℤ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ z ∈ A04.validPairs (2 * h) m, seaNormalBilinear h ν z.1 z.2

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.quarticSeaWick
commands.text:
noncomputable def quarticSeaWick (h : ℕ) (ν : σ)
    (a b c d : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  seaWickWord h ν (quarticWord h a b c d)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.quarticContraction
commands.text:
noncomputable def quarticContraction (h : ℕ) (ν : σ)
    (k p : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  seaIndicator h p • seaSubtractedNumber h ν k -
    (1 - seaIndicator h k) • seaSubtractedNumber h ν p -
    (seaIndicator h p * (1 - seaIndicator h k)) • (1 : A05.Operators σ h)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaWickTerm
commands.text:
noncomputable def seaWickTerm (h M : ℕ) (ν : σ)
    (k : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  if k.val ≤ 0 then
    (seaWickWeight h M k : ℂ) • ((1 : A05.Operators σ h) - numberOp h ν k)
  else
    (seaWickWeight h M k : ℂ) • numberOp h ν k

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.seaWickCorrection
commands.text:
noncomputable def seaWickCorrection (h M : ℕ) (ν : σ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ k : Ch01.Band (2 * h), seaWickTerm h M ν k

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.computationalMomentum
commands.text:
noncomputable def computationalMomentum (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ k : Ch01.Band (2 * h), (k.val : ℂ) • seaSubtractedNumber h ν k

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.speciesRawIntra
commands.text:
noncomputable def speciesRawIntra (h M : ℕ) (ν : σ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc (-(M : ℤ)) (M : ℤ),
    ∑ z ∈ A04.validPairs (2 * h) m,
      ∑ w ∈ A04.validPairs (2 * h) (-m),
        quarticSeaWick h ν z.1 z.2 w.1 w.2

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.rawIntraBranch
commands.text:
noncomputable def rawIntraBranch (h M : ℕ) (g4 : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ((g4 : ℂ) / (2 * ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ))) •
    (speciesRawIntra h M branches.rightSpecies +
      speciesRawIntra h M branches.leftSpecies)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.speciesCurrentIntra
commands.text:
noncomputable def speciesCurrentIntra (h M : ℕ) (ν : σ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  (2 : ℂ) • (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    A05.rho h ν (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h ν (-(m : ℤ))) +
    A05.chargeObservable h ν * A05.chargeObservable h ν

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.currentIntraBranch
commands.text:
noncomputable def currentIntraBranch (h M : ℕ) (g4 : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ((g4 : ℂ) / (2 * ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ))) •
    (speciesCurrentIntra h M branches.rightSpecies +
      speciesCurrentIntra h M branches.leftSpecies)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.rawInterBranch
commands.text:
noncomputable def rawInterBranch (h M : ℕ) (g2 : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ((g2 : ℂ) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)) •
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc (-(M : ℤ)) (M : ℤ),
      seaNormalRho h branches.rightSpecies m *
        seaNormalRho h branches.leftSpecies (-m)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.hoppingInterBranch
commands.text:
noncomputable def hoppingInterBranch (h M : ℕ) (g2 : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  let r := branches.rightSpecies
  let l := branches.leftSpecies
  ((g2 : ℂ) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)) •
    (A05.chargeObservable h r * A05.chargeObservable h l +
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
        (A05.rho h r (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h l (-(m : ℤ)) +
          A05.rho h r (-(m : ℤ)) * A05.rho h l (m : ℤ)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.pairingInterBranch
commands.text:
noncomputable def pairingInterBranch (h M : ℕ) (g2 : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  let r := branches.rightSpecies
  let l := branches.leftSpecies
  ((g2 : ℂ) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)) •
    (A05.chargeObservable h r * A05.chargeObservable h l +
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
        (A05.rho h r (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h l (m : ℤ) +
          A05.rho h r (-(m : ℤ)) * A05.rho h l (-(m : ℤ))))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.hoppingMode
commands.text:
noncomputable def hoppingMode (h m : ℕ) (v1 v2 : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  let r := branches.rightSpecies
  let l := branches.leftSpecies
  (v1 : ℂ) • (A05.rho h r (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h r (-(m : ℤ)) +
    A05.rho h l (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h l (-(m : ℤ))) +
  (v2 : ℂ) • (A05.rho h r (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h l (-(m : ℤ)) +
    A05.rho h l (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h r (-(m : ℤ)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.pairingMode
commands.text:
noncomputable def pairingMode (h m : ℕ) (v1 v2 : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  let r := branches.rightSpecies
  let l := branches.leftSpecies
  (v1 : ℂ) • (A05.rho h r (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h r (-(m : ℤ)) +
    A05.rho h l (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h l (-(m : ℤ))) +
  (v2 : ℂ) • (A05.rho h r (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h l (m : ℤ) +
    A05.rho h r (-(m : ℤ)) * A05.rho h l (-(m : ℤ)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator
commands.text:
noncomputable def bogoliubovCreator (h m : ℕ) (c s : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  (c : ℂ) • A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches η) (m : ℤ) +
    (s : ℂ) • A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches (oppositeOrientation η)) (-(m : ℤ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator
commands.text:
noncomputable def bogoliubovAnnihilator (h m : ℕ) (c s : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
