  (c : ℂ) • A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches η) (-(m : ℤ)) +
    (s : ℂ) • A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches (oppositeOrientation η)) (m : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A07Interactions.dressedModeNumber
commands.text:
noncomputable def dressedModeNumber (h m : ℕ) (u c s : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  (u : ℂ) • (bogoliubovCreator h m c s branches .right *
      bogoliubovAnnihilator h m c s branches .right +
    bogoliubovCreator h m c s branches .left *
      bogoliubovAnnihilator h m c s branches .left)

Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubov_ccr_.text: theorem bogoliubov_ccr_on_budget (h M K m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 - s ^ 2 = 1) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : A02.commutator (bogoliubovAnnihilator h m c s branches η) (bogoliubovCreator h m c s branches η) v = (m : ℂ) • v

Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubov_crea.text: lemma bogoliubov_creator_adjoint (h m : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) : LinearMap.adjoint (bogoliubovCreator h m c s branches η) = bogoliubovAnnihilator h m c s branches η

Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubov_expa.text: theorem bogoliubov_expansion_on_budget (h M K m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) (v1 v2 : ℝ) (hp : HyperbolicParams v1 v2) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : dressedModeNumber h m hp.u hp.c hp.s branches v = pairingMode h m v1 v2 branches v + ((2 * hp.u * hp.s ^ 2 * (m : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • v

Bosonize.A07Interactions.hopping_mode_ki.text: lemma hopping_mode_kills_ground (h m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : (A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h branches.leftSpecies (-(m : ℤ)) + A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (-(m : ℤ)) * A05.rho h branches.leftSpecies (m : ℤ)) (A05.groundKet h Ns) = 0

Bosonize.A07Interactions.hopping_mode_se.text: lemma hopping_mode_self_adjoint (h m : ℕ) (v1 v2 : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : LinearMap.adjoint (hoppingMode h m v1 v2 branches) = hoppingMode h m v1 v2 branches

Bosonize.A07Interactions.hyperbolic_para.text: theorem hyperbolic_params_exist (v1 v2 : ℝ) (hstab : |v2| < v1) : ∃ u c s : ℝ, 0 < u ∧ u ^ 2 = v1 ^ 2 - v2 ^ 2 ∧ c ^ 2 - s ^ 2 = 1 ∧ v1 = u * (c ^ 2 + s ^ 2) ∧ v2 = 2 * u * c * s

Bosonize.A07Interactions.pairing_mode_gr.text: lemma pairing_mode_ground_nonzero (h M m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (hmargin : A06.branchMargins h M m Ns branches) : (A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (m : ℤ) * A05.rho h branches.leftSpecies (m : ℤ) + A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (-(m : ℤ)) * A05.rho h branches.leftSpecies (-(m : ℤ))) (A05.groundKet h Ns) ≠ 0

Bosonize.A07Interactions.pairing_mode_se.text: lemma pairing_mode_self_adjoint (h m : ℕ) (v1 v2 : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : LinearMap.adjoint (pairingMode h m v1 v2 branches) = pairingMode h m v1 v2 branches

Bosonize.A07Interactions.quartic_sea_wic.text: lemma quartic_sea_wick_identity (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (m : ℤ) (z w : Ch01.Band (2 * h) × Ch01.Band (2 * h)) (hz : z ∈ A04.validPairs (2 * h) m) (hw : w ∈ A04.validPairs (2 * h) (-m)) : quarticSeaWick h ν z.1 z.2 w.1 w.2 = seaNormalBilinear h ν z.1 z.2 * seaNormalBilinear h ν w.1 w.2 + if w.2 = z.1 then quarticContraction h ν z.2 w.2 else 0
lemma quartic_sea_wick_zero_repeated (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (k : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : quarticSeaWick h ν k k k k = 0 ∧ seaNormalBilinear h ν k k * seaNormalBilinear h ν k k + quarticContraction h ν k k = 0

Bosonize.A07Interactions.raw_inter_eq_ho.text: theorem raw_inter_eq_hopping (h M : ℕ) (g2 : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : rawInterBranch h M g2 branches = hoppingInterBranch h M g2 branches

Bosonize.A07Interactions.raw_intra_eq_cu.text: theorem raw_intra_eq_current_sub_correction (h M : ℕ) (g4 : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : rawIntraBranch h M g4 branches = currentIntraBranch h M g4 branches - ((g4 : ℂ) / (2 * ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ))) • (seaWickCorrection h M branches.rightSpecies + seaWickCorrection h M branches.leftSpecies)

Bosonize.A07Interactions.sea_normal_bili.text: lemma sea_normal_bilinear_diag (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (k : Ch01.Band (2 * h)) : seaNormalBilinear h ν k k = if k.val ≤ 0 then -(A05.annihilation h ν k * A05.creation h ν k) else A05.creation h ν k * A05.annihilation h ν k

Bosonize.A07Interactions.sea_normal_rho_.text: lemma sea_normal_rho_nonzero (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) (m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ 0) : seaNormalRho h ν m = A05.rho h ν m
lemma sea_normal_rho_zero (h : ℕ) (ν : σ) : seaNormalRho h ν 0 = A05.chargeObservable h ν

Bosonize.A07Interactions.sea_wick_correc.text: lemma sea_wick_correction_full_band (h M : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hM : h - 1 ≤ M) (ν : σ) : seaWickCorrection h M ν = (2 : ℂ) • computationalMomentum h ν - A05.chargeObservable h ν
lemma sea_wick_correction_ground_zero (h M : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (ν : σ) : seaWickCorrection h M ν (A05.groundKet h (fun _ : σ => 0)) = 0

Bosonize.A07Interactions.species_raw_int.text: lemma species_raw_intra_eq_current_sub_correction (h M : ℕ) (ν : σ) : speciesRawIntra h M ν = speciesCurrentIntra h M ν - seaWickCorrection h M ν

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swGeneratorMatrix
commands.text:
noncomputable def swGeneratorMatrix {ι : Type*}
    (inLow : ι → Bool) (E : ι → ℝ) (Voff : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    Matrix ι ι ℂ :=
  fun i j =>
    if inLow i ≠ inLow j ∧ Voff i j ≠ 0 then
      Voff i j / ((E i - E j : ℝ) : ℂ)
    else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.diagEnergyMatrix
commands.text:
noncomputable def diagEnergyMatrix {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (E : ι → ℝ) : Matrix ι ι ℂ :=
  Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((E i : ℝ) : ℂ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.nonResonant
def Bosonize.A10.swCounterH0_2x2
commands.text:
def swCounterH0_2x2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun i j => if i = 1 ∧ j = 1 then 1 else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swCounterV_2x2
commands.text:
def swCounterV_2x2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun i j => if i ≠ j then 1 else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swCounterS1_2x2
commands.text:
def swCounterS1_2x2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun i j => if i = 0 ∧ j = 1 then -1 else if i = 1 ∧ j = 0 then 1 else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swCounterP_2x2
commands.text:
def swCounterP_2x2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun i j => if i = 0 ∧ j = 0 then 1 else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swCounterH0_3x3
commands.text:
def swCounterH0_3x3 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ :=
  fun i j =>
    if i = j then
      if i = 0 then 0 else if i = 1 then -1 else 1
    else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swCounterP_3x3
commands.text:
def swCounterP_3x3 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ :=
  fun i j => if i = 0 ∧ j = 0 then 1 else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swCounterQ_3x3
commands.text:
def swCounterQ_3x3 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ :=
  fun i j => if i = j ∧ (i = 1 ∨ i = 2) then 1 else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swCounterV_3x3
commands.text:
def swCounterV_3x3 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ :=
  fun i j =>
    if (i = 0 ∧ (j = 1 ∨ j = 2)) ∨ ((i = 1 ∨ i = 2) ∧ j = 0) then 1
    else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swCounterS1_3x3
commands.text:
def swCounterS1_3x3 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ :=
  fun i j =>
    if i = 0 ∧ j = 1 then 1
    else if i = 0 ∧ j = 2 then -1
    else if i = 1 ∧ j = 0 then -1
    else if i = 2 ∧ j = 0 then 1
    else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swCounterEigenvector_2x2
commands.text:
def swCounterEigenvector_2x2 : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  fun i => if i = 0 then -2 else 1

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.exactShellSet
def Bosonize.A10.lowShellProj
commands.text:
noncomputable def lowShellProj (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  Ch14.projection h Ns (K - 1)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.highShellProj
commands.text:
noncomputable def highShellProj (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℕ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  letI : DecidableEq (A05.Mode σ h) := (A05.speciesOrder h).toDecidableEq
  A03.coordinateProjection (exactShellSet h Ns K)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.doubleModeOneKet
commands.text:
noncomputable def doubleModeOneKet (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) :
    A05.FockSpace σ h :=
  A05.rho h ν 1 (A05.rho h ν 1 (A05.groundKet h Ns))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.diagPart
commands.text:
noncomputable def diagPart (h : ℕ) (P Q V : A05.Operators σ h) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  P * V * P + Q * V * Q

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.offDiagPart
commands.text:
noncomputable def offDiagPart (h : ℕ) (P Q V : A05.Operators σ h) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  P * V * Q + Q * V * P

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swSecondOrderCorrection
commands.text:
noncomputable def swSecondOrderCorrection (h : ℕ)
    (P S1 V : A05.Operators σ h) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (P * A02.commutator S1 V * P)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.swEffectiveSecondOrder
commands.text:
noncomputable def swEffectiveSecondOrder (h : ℕ)
    (P H0 V S1 : A05.Operators σ h) (t : ℝ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  P * H0 * P + (t : ℂ) • (P * V * P) +
    ((t : ℂ) ^ 2) • swSecondOrderCorrection h P S1 V

commands.label: def Bosonize.A10.bchSecondOrderPolynomial
commands.text:
noncomputable def bchSecondOrderPolynomial (h : ℕ)
    (H0 V S1 : A05.Operators σ h) (t : ℝ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  H0 + (t : ℂ) • (V + A02.commutator S1 H0) +
    ((t : ℂ) ^ 2) • (A02.commutator S1 V +
      ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • A02.commutator S1 (A02.commutator S1 H0))

Bosonize.A10.energy_shell_discards_doubl.text: lemma energy_shell_discards_double_mode_one (h : ℕ) (hh : 2 ≤ h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (ν : σ) (hR2 : A05.r2 h 2 Ns) : doubleModeOneKet h Ns ν ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns 2 ∧ doubleModeOneKet h Ns ν ≠ 0 ∧ lowShellProj h Ns 2 (doubleModeOneKet h Ns ν) = 0 ∧ highShellProj h Ns 2 (doubleModeOneKet h Ns ν) = doubleModeOneKet h Ns ν

Bosonize.A10.shell_proj_orthogonal.text: lemma shell_proj_orthogonal (h K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : lowShellProj h Ns K * highShellProj h Ns K = 0 ∧ highShellProj h Ns K * lowShellProj h Ns K = 0

Bosonize.A10.shell_proj_partition.text: lemma shell_proj_partition (h K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : lowShellProj h Ns K + highShellProj h Ns K = Ch14.projection h Ns K

Bosonize.A10.shell_proj_self_adjoint.text: lemma shell_proj_self_adjoint (h K : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : LinearMap.adjoint (lowShellProj h Ns K) = lowShellProj h Ns K ∧ LinearMap.adjoint (highShellProj h Ns K) = highShellProj h Ns K

Bosonize.A10.sw_2x2_exact_eigenpair.text: theorem sw_2x2_exact_eigenpair : swCounterEigenvector_2x2 ≠ 0 ∧ (swCounterH0_2x2 + ((2 : ℂ) / 3) • swCounterV_2x2).mulVec swCounterEigenvector_2x2 = ((-1 : ℂ) / 3) • swCounterEigenvector_2x2

Bosonize.A10.sw_2x2_truncation_witness.text: theorem sw_2x2_truncation_witness : swCounterS1_2x2 * swCounterH0_2x2 - swCounterH0_2x2 * swCounterS1_2x2 = -swCounterV_2x2 ∧ (swCounterP_2x2 * (swCounterS1_2x2 * swCounterV_2x2 - swCounterV_2x2 * swCounterS1_2x2) * swCounterP_2x2) 0 0 = -2 ∧ ((-((2 : ℚ) / 3) ^ 2 : ℚ) ≠ (-1 / 3 : ℚ))

Bosonize.A10.sw_3x3_no_iff_witness.text: theorem sw_3x3_no_iff_witness : swCounterS1_3x3 * swCounterH0_3x3 - swCounterH0_3x3 * swCounterS1_3x3 = -swCounterV_3x3 ∧ swCounterP_3x3 * swCounterV_3x3 * swCounterQ_3x3 ≠ 0 ∧ swCounterP_3x3 * (swCounterS1_3x3 * swCounterV_3x3 - swCounterV_3x3 * swCounterS1_3x3) * swCounterP_3x3 = 0

Bosonize.A10.sw_compressed_bch_second_or.text: theorem sw_compressed_bch_second_order (h : ℕ) (P Q H0 V S1 : A05.Operators σ h) (t : ℝ) (hP : P * P = P) (hQ : Q * Q = Q) (hPartition : P + Q = 1) (hPQ : P * Q = 0) (hQP : Q * P = 0) (hBaseline : A02.commutator P H0 = 0) (hSpp : P * S1 * P = 0) (hSqq : Q * S1 * Q = 0) (hGenerator : A02.commutator S1 H0 = -offDiagPart h P Q V) : P * bchSecondOrderPolynomial h H0 V S1 t * P = swEffectiveSecondOrder h P H0 V S1 t

Bosonize.A10.sw_generator_commutator_eq.text: theorem sw_generator_commutator_eq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (inLow : ι → Bool) (E : ι → ℝ) (Voff : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hBlock : ∀ i j : ι, inLow i = inLow j → Voff i j = 0) (hNonRes : nonResonant inLow E Voff) : swGeneratorMatrix inLow E Voff * diagEnergyMatrix E - diagEnergyMatrix E * swGeneratorMatrix inLow E Voff = -Voff

Bosonize.A10.sw_generator_skew_hermitian.text: theorem sw_generator_skew_hermitian {ι : Type*} (inLow : ι → Bool) (E : ι → ℝ) (Voff : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hHerm : Matrix.conjTranspose Voff = Voff) : Matrix.conjTranspose (swGeneratorMatrix inLow E Voff) = -swGeneratorMatrix inLow E Voff

Bosonize.A10.sw_off_zero_implies_effecti.text: theorem sw_off_zero_implies_effective_exact (h : ℕ) (P Q H0 V : A05.Operators σ h) (t : ℝ) (hPVQ : P * V * Q = 0) (hQVP : Q * V * P = 0) : offDiagPart h P Q V = 0 ∧ swSecondOrderCorrection h P (0 : A05.Operators σ h) V = 0 ∧ swEffectiveSecondOrder h P H0 V (0 : A05.Operators σ h) t = P * H0 * P + (t : ℂ) • (P * V * P)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.v1Velocity
commands.text:
noncomputable def v1Velocity (vF g4 : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  vF + g4 / (2 * Real.pi)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.v2Velocity
commands.text:
noncomputable def v2Velocity (g2 : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  g2 / (2 * Real.pi)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.canonicalMu
commands.text:
noncomputable def canonicalMu (h : ℕ) (vF : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi * vF / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℝ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.sugawaraMargin
commands.text:
def sugawaraMargin {σ : Type*} (h M K : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : Prop :=
  K ≤ M ∧
    (K : ℤ) + |Ns branches.rightSpecies| < (h : ℤ) ∧
    (K : ℤ) + |Ns branches.leftSpecies| < (h : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.zeroModeEnergyScalar
def Bosonize.Ch17.symmetricZeroModeScalar
def Bosonize.Ch17.chemicalPotentialOp
commands.text:
noncomputable def chemicalPotentialOp (h : ℕ) (mu : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  (mu : ℂ) • (A05.chargeObservable h branches.rightSpecies +
    A05.chargeObservable h branches.leftSpecies)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.freeSugawaraKinetic
commands.text:
noncomputable def freeSugawaraKinetic (h M : ℕ) (vF : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  let r := branches.rightSpecies
  let l := branches.leftSpecies
  let prefactor : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi * vF : ℝ) : ℂ) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)
  prefactor • (Ch16.sugawara h M branches +
    ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (A05.chargeObservable h r * (A05.chargeObservable h r + 1) +
      A05.chargeObservable h l * (A05.chargeObservable h l + 1)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.freeFermionKinetic
commands.text:
noncomputable def freeFermionKinetic (h : ℕ) (vF : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  let prefactor : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi * vF : ℝ) : ℂ) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)
  prefactor •
    (A07Interactions.computationalMomentum h branches.rightSpecies +
      A07Interactions.computationalMomentum h branches.leftSpecies)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.zeroModeEnergyOp
commands.text:
noncomputable def zeroModeEnergyOp (h : ℕ) (vF g4 g2 mu : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  let L : ℂ := ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)
  let nr := A05.chargeObservable h branches.rightSpecies
  let nl := A05.chargeObservable h branches.leftSpecies
  (((2 * Real.pi * vF : ℝ) : ℂ) / L) •
      (((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (nr * (nr + 1) + nl * (nl + 1))) +
    ((g4 : ℂ) / (2 * L)) • (nr * nr + nl * nl) +
    ((g2 : ℂ) / L) • (nr * nl) -
    chemicalPotentialOp h mu branches

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.luttingerOscillatorOp
commands.text:
noncomputable def luttingerOscillatorOp (h M : ℕ) (vF g4 g2 : ℝ)
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)) •
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
      A07Interactions.pairingMode h m
        (v1Velocity vF g4) (v2Velocity g2) branches

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.luttingerBosonizedHamiltonian
commands.text:
noncomputable def luttingerBosonizedHamiltonian (h M : ℕ)
    (vF g4 g2 mu : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  luttingerOscillatorOp h M vF g4 g2 branches +
    zeroModeEnergyOp h vF g4 g2 mu branches

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.luttingerChosenModel
commands.text:
noncomputable def luttingerChosenModel (h M : ℕ)
    (vF g4 g2 mu : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  freeSugawaraKinetic h M vF branches +
    A07Interactions.currentIntraBranch h M g4 branches +
    A07Interactions.pairingInterBranch h M g2 branches -
    chemicalPotentialOp h mu branches

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch17.luttingerFermionChosenModel
commands.text:
noncomputable def luttingerFermionChosenModel (h M : ℕ)
    (vF g4 g2 mu : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  freeFermionKinetic h vF branches +
    A07Interactions.currentIntraBranch h M g4 branches +
    A07Interactions.pairingInterBranch h M g2 branches -
    chemicalPotentialOp h mu branches

Bosonize.Ch17.concrete_luttinger_witness.text: theorem concrete_luttinger_witness : let Ns : Fin 2 → ℤ := fun _ => 0 A05.admissible 8 Ns ∧ A06.branchMargins 8 2 2 Ns Ch16.standardBranches ∧ sugawaraMargin 8 2 2 Ns Ch16.standardBranches ∧ A05.groundKet 8 Ns ∈ A05.jointBudget 8 Ns 2 ∧ A05.groundKet 8 Ns ≠ 0 ∧ luttingerBosonizedHamiltonian 8 2 1 (6 * Real.pi) (6 * Real.pi) (canonicalMu 8 1) Ch16.standardBranches (A05.groundKet 8 Ns) ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch17.free_fermion_eq_sugawara_o.text: theorem free_fermion_eq_sugawara_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (vF : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hSug : sugawaraMargin h M K Ns branches) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : freeFermionKinetic h vF branches v = freeSugawaraKinetic h M vF branches v

Bosonize.Ch17.luttinger_chosen_eq_bosoni.text: theorem luttinger_chosen_eq_bosonized (h M : ℕ) (vF g4 g2 mu : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : luttingerChosenModel h M vF g4 g2 mu branches = luttingerBosonizedHamiltonian h M vF g4 g2 mu branches

Bosonize.Ch17.luttinger_hamiltonian_cano.text: theorem luttinger_hamiltonian_canonical_mu_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (vF g4 g2 : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hSug : sugawaraMargin h M K Ns branches) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : luttingerFermionChosenModel h M vF g4 g2 (canonicalMu h vF) branches v = luttingerOscillatorOp h M vF g4 g2 branches v + (symmetricZeroModeScalar h vF g4 g2 branches Ns : ℂ) • v

Bosonize.Ch17.luttinger_hamiltonian_on_b.text: theorem luttinger_hamiltonian_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (vF g4 g2 mu : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hSug : sugawaraMargin h M K Ns branches) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : luttingerFermionChosenModel h M vF g4 g2 mu branches v = luttingerOscillatorOp h M vF g4 g2 branches v + (zeroModeEnergyScalar h vF g4 g2 mu branches Ns : ℂ) • v

Bosonize.Ch17.luttinger_raw_intra_on_bud.text: theorem luttinger_raw_intra_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (vF g4 g2 mu : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hSug : sugawaraMargin h M K Ns branches) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : (freeFermionKinetic h vF branches + A07Interactions.rawIntraBranch h M g4 branches + A07Interactions.pairingInterBranch h M g2 branches - chemicalPotentialOp h mu branches) v = luttingerOscillatorOp h M vF g4 g2 branches v + (zeroModeEnergyScalar h vF g4 g2 mu branches Ns : ℂ) • v - (((g4 : ℂ) / (2 * ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ))) • (A07Interactions.seaWickCorrection h M branches.rightSpecies + A07Interactions.seaWickCorrection h M branches.leftSpecies)) v

Bosonize.Ch17.zero_mode_op_on_budget.text: lemma zero_mode_op_on_budget (h K : ℕ) (vF g4 g2 mu : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (v : A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : zeroModeEnergyOp h vF g4 g2 mu branches v = (zeroModeEnergyScalar h vF g4 g2 mu branches Ns : ℂ) • v

Bosonize.Ch17.zero_mode_scalar_canonical.text: lemma zero_mode_scalar_canonical_mu {σ : Type*} (h : ℕ) (vF g4 g2 : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : zeroModeEnergyScalar h vF g4 g2 (canonicalMu h vF) branches Ns = symmetricZeroModeScalar h vF g4 g2 branches Ns

commands.label: structure Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair
commands.text:
structure HyperbolicPair where
  c : ℝ
  s : ℝ
  hyperbolic_id : c ^ 2 - s ^ 2 = 1

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair.ofParams
commands.text:
def HyperbolicPair.ofParams {v1 v2 : ℝ}
    (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : HyperbolicPair where
  c := hp.c
  s := hp.s
  hyperbolic_id := hp.hyperbolic_id

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch18.LuttingerParams
commands.text: abbrev LuttingerParams (v1 v2 : ℝ) := Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch18.LuttingerParams.toHyperbolicPair
def Bosonize.Ch18.vacuumShiftScalar
commands.text:
noncomputable def vacuumShiftScalar (h M : ℕ) (u s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (2 * u * s ^ 2 * (m : ℝ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch18.concreteParams
commands.text:
noncomputable def concreteParams : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams concreteV1 concreteV2 where
  u := 8
  c := 5 / 4
  s := 3 / 4
  u_pos := by
    norm_num
  c_pos := by
    norm_num
  u_sq := by
    norm_num [concreteV1, concreteV2]
  hyperbolic_id := by
    norm_num
  match_v1 := by
    norm_num [concreteV1]
  match_v2 := by
    norm_num [concreteV2]

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair
commands.text:
noncomputable def concretePair : HyperbolicPair :=
  HyperbolicPair.ofParams concreteParams

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch18.dressedOscillatorOp
commands.text:
noncomputable def dressedOscillatorOp (h M : ℕ) (u c s : ℝ)
    (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) : Bosonize.A05.Operators σ h :=
  ((((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ))) •
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, Bosonize.A07Interactions.dressedModeNumber h m u c s branches

Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair.inverse_com.text: theorem HyperbolicPair.inverse_combination {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (hp : HyperbolicPair) (X Y : E) : (hp.c : ℂ) • ((hp.c : ℂ) • X + (hp.s : ℂ) • Y) - (hp.s : ℂ) • ((hp.c : ℂ) • Y + (hp.s : ℂ) • X) = X

Bosonize.Ch18.bogoliubov_annihilator_inv.text: theorem bogoliubov_annihilator_inverse_left (h m : ℕ) (hp : HyperbolicPair) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) : Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.leftSpecies (-(m : ℤ)) = (hp.c : ℂ) • Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .left - (hp.s : ℂ) • Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m hp.c hp.s branches .right

theorem bogoliubov_annihilator_inverse_right (h m : ℕ) (hp : HyperbolicPair) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) : Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (-(m : ℤ)) = (hp.c : ℂ) • Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .right - (hp.s : ℂ) • Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m hp.c hp.s branches .left

Bosonize.Ch18.bogoliubov_creator_inverse.text: theorem bogoliubov_creator_inverse_left (h m : ℕ) (hp : HyperbolicPair) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) : Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.leftSpecies (m : ℤ) = (hp.c : ℂ) • Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m hp.c hp.s branches .left - (hp.s : ℂ) • Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .right

theorem bogoliubov_creator_inverse_right (h m : ℕ) (hp : HyperbolicPair) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) : Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (m : ℤ) = (hp.c : ℂ) • Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m hp.c hp.s branches .right - (hp.s : ℂ) • Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .left

Bosonize.Ch18.bogoliubov_cross_annihilat.text: theorem bogoliubov_cross_annihilator_annihilator_on_budget (h M K m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) (c s : ℝ) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (v : Bosonize.A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ Bosonize.A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : Bosonize.A02.commutator (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m c s branches .right) (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m c s branches .left) v = 0

theorem bogoliubov_cross_annihilator_creator (h m : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (η : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) : Bosonize.A02.commutator (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m c s branches η) (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m c s branches (Bosonize.A07Interactions.oppositeOrientation η)) = 0

Bosonize.Ch18.bogoliubov_cross_creator_c.text: theorem bogoliubov_cross_creator_creator_on_budget (h M K m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) (c s : ℝ) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (v : Bosonize.A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ Bosonize.A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : Bosonize.A02.commutator (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m c s branches .right) (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m c s branches .left) v = 0

Bosonize.Ch18.concrete_bogoliubov_witnes.text: theorem concrete_bogoliubov_witness : Bosonize.A05.admissible concreteCarrierH concreteNs ∧ Bosonize.A06.branchMargins concreteCarrierH concreteCutoff concreteBudget concreteNs concreteBranches ∧ Bosonize.Ch17.sugawaraMargin concreteCarrierH concreteCutoff concreteBudget concreteNs concreteBranches ∧ concreteParams.s ≠ 0 ∧ Bosonize.A05.groundKet concreteCarrierH concreteNs ∈ Bosonize.A05.jointBudget concreteCarrierH concreteNs concreteBudget ∧ Bosonize.A05.groundKet concreteCarrierH concreteNs ≠ 0 ∧ Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator concreteCarrierH concreteMode concreteParams.c concreteParams.s concreteBranches .right (Bosonize.A05.groundKet concreteCarrierH concreteNs) ≠ 0 ∧ Bosonize.A07Interactions.dressedModeNumber concreteCarrierH concreteMode concreteParams.u concreteParams.c concreteParams.s concreteBranches (Bosonize.A05.groundKet concreteCarrierH concreteNs) ≠ 0 ∧ vacuumShiftScalar concreteCarrierH concreteCutoff concreteParams.u concreteParams.s ≠ 0 ∧ vacuumShiftScalar concreteCarrierH concreteCutoff concreteParams.u concreteParams.s = 27 * Real.pi / 8 ∧ luttingerG concretePair = 1 / 4 ∧ 2 * concreteParams.u * concreteParams.s ^ 2 = 9

Bosonize.Ch18.concrete_velocity_match.text: theorem concrete_velocity_match : concreteV1 = Bosonize.Ch17.v1Velocity concreteVF concreteG4 ∧ concreteV2 = Bosonize.Ch17.v2Velocity concreteG2

Bosonize.Ch18.dressed_annihilator_ground.text: theorem dressed_annihilator_ground_left (h m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) : Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .left (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) = (hp.s : ℂ) • Bosonize.Ch16.excitedKet h Ns branches .right m

theorem dressed_annihilator_ground_left_ne_zero (h M m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) (hs : hp.s ≠ 0) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.marginAt h M m Ns (Bosonize.A06.speciesOf branches .right)) : Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .left (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) ≠ 0

theorem dressed_annihilator_ground_right (h m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) : Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .right (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) = (hp.s : ℂ) • Bosonize.Ch16.excitedKet h Ns branches .left m

theorem dressed_annihilator_ground_right_ne_zero (h M m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) (hs : hp.s ≠ 0) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.marginAt h M m Ns (Bosonize.A06.speciesOf branches .left)) : Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .right (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch18.hyperbolic_coeff_eq_luttin.text: theorem hyperbolic_coeff_eq_luttinger (hp : HyperbolicPair) : hp.c ^ 2 + hp.s ^ 2 = (luttingerG hp + (luttingerG hp)⁻¹) / 2

Bosonize.Ch18.hyperbolic_params_nonempty.text: theorem hyperbolic_params_nonempty (v1 v2 : ℝ) (hstab : |v2| < v1) : Nonempty (Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2)

Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerGInv_eq_inv.text: theorem luttingerGInv_eq_inv (hp : HyperbolicPair) : luttingerGInv hp = (luttingerG hp)⁻¹

Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerGInv_mul_u_of_par.text: theorem luttingerGInv_mul_u_of_params {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : luttingerGInv (HyperbolicPair.ofParams hp) * hp.u = v1 + v2

Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerGInv_pos_of_param.text: theorem luttingerGInv_pos_of_params {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : 0 < luttingerGInv (HyperbolicPair.ofParams hp)

Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG_eq_sqrt_of_para.text: theorem luttingerG_eq_sqrt_of_params {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : luttingerG (HyperbolicPair.ofParams hp) = Real.sqrt ((v1 - v2) / (v1 + v2))

Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG_mul_inv.text: theorem luttingerG_mul_inv (hp : HyperbolicPair) : luttingerG hp * luttingerGInv hp = 1

Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG_mul_u_of_params.text: theorem luttingerG_mul_u_of_params {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : luttingerG (HyperbolicPair.ofParams hp) * hp.u = v1 - v2

Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG_pos_of_params.text: theorem luttingerG_pos_of_params {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : 0 < luttingerG (HyperbolicPair.ofParams hp)

Bosonize.Ch18.luttinger_hamiltonian_dres.text: theorem luttinger_hamiltonian_dressed_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (vF g4 g2 mu : ℝ) {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hv1 : v1 = Bosonize.Ch17.v1Velocity vF g4) (hv2 : v2 = Bosonize.Ch17.v2Velocity g2) (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hSug : Bosonize.Ch17.sugawaraMargin h M K Ns branches) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (v : Bosonize.A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ Bosonize.A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : Bosonize.Ch17.luttingerFermionChosenModel h M vF g4 g2 mu branches v = (dressedOscillatorOp h M hp.u hp.c hp.s branches) v + (((Bosonize.Ch17.zeroModeEnergyScalar h vF g4 g2 mu branches Ns - vacuumShiftScalar h M hp.u hp.s : ℝ) : ℂ)) • v

Bosonize.Ch18.luttinger_oscillator_dress.text: theorem luttinger_oscillator_dressed_on_budget (h M K : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (vF g4 g2 : ℝ) {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hv1 : v1 = Bosonize.Ch17.v1Velocity vF g4) (hv2 : v2 = Bosonize.Ch17.v2Velocity g2) (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (v : Bosonize.A05.FockSpace σ h) (hv : v ∈ Bosonize.A05.jointBudget h Ns K) : Bosonize.Ch17.luttingerOscillatorOp h M vF g4 g2 branches v = (dressedOscillatorOp h M hp.u hp.c hp.s branches) v - (((vacuumShiftScalar h M hp.u hp.s : ℝ) : ℂ)) • v

Bosonize.Ch18.no_common_bare_dressed_vac.text: theorem no_common_bare_dressed_vacuum (h M K m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : m ≤ M) {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) (hs : hp.s ≠ 0) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.branchMargins h M K Ns branches) (ψ : Bosonize.A05.FockSpace σ h) (hψ : ψ ≠ 0) (hψbudget : ψ ∈ Bosonize.A05.jointBudget h Ns K) (hbareR : Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (-(m : ℤ)) ψ = 0) (hbareL : Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.leftSpecies (-(m : ℤ)) ψ = 0) (hdressR : Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .right ψ = 0) (hdressL : Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches .left ψ = 0) : False

Bosonize.Ch18.tanh_relation_of_params.text: theorem tanh_relation_of_params {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : v2 * (hp.c ^ 2 + hp.s ^ 2) = v1 * (2 * hp.c * hp.s)

Bosonize.Ch18.u_lt_v1_of_v2_ne_zero.text: theorem u_lt_v1_of_v2_ne_zero {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) (hv1 : 0 < v1) (hv2 : v2 ≠ 0) : hp.u < v1

Bosonize.Ch18.v2_eq_zero_iff_s_eq_zero.text: theorem v2_eq_zero_iff_s_eq_zero {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : v2 = 0 ↔ hp.s = 0

Bosonize.Ch18.vacuum_shift_prefactor_of_.text: theorem vacuum_shift_prefactor_of_params {v1 v2 : ℝ} (hp : Bosonize.A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : 2 * hp.u * hp.s ^ 2 = v1 - hp.u

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A08.OscMode
commands.text: abbrev OscMode (M : ℕ) := Bosonize.A06.Orientation × Fin M

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.oscWeight
commands.text: def oscWeight {M : ℕ} (p : OscMode M) : ℕ := p.2.val + 1

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A08.OscPoly
commands.text: abbrev OscPoly (M : ℕ) := MvPolynomial (OscMode M) ℂ

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.oscMonomialNorm
commands.text:
def oscMonomialNorm {M : ℕ} (r : OscMode M →₀ ℕ) : ℕ :=
  r.prod (fun p k => oscWeight p ^ k * k.factorial)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.oscPairing
commands.text:
noncomputable def oscPairing (M : ℕ) (p q : OscPoly M) : ℂ :=
  ∑ r ∈ p.support, star (MvPolynomial.lcoeff ℂ r p) * (oscMonomialNorm r : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.lcoeff ℂ r q

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.oscCreation
commands.text:
noncomputable def oscCreation (M : ℕ) (p : OscMode M) : Module.End ℂ (OscPoly M) :=
  LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (MvPolynomial.X p)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.oscAnnihilation
commands.text:
noncomputable def oscAnnihilation (M : ℕ) (p : OscMode M) : Module.End ℂ (OscPoly M) :=
  (oscWeight p : ℂ) • (MvPolynomial.pderiv p).toLinearMap

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A08.OscGen
commands.text: abbrev OscGen (M : ℕ) := Bool × OscMode M

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.A08.OscAlgebra
commands.text: abbrev OscAlgebra (M : ℕ) := FreeAlgebra ℂ (OscGen M)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.creatorGen
commands.text:
noncomputable def creatorGen (M : ℕ) (ν : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) (i : Fin M) : OscAlgebra M :=
  FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, (ν, i))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen
commands.text:
noncomputable def annihilatorGen (M : ℕ) (ν : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) (i : Fin M) : OscAlgebra M :=
  FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, (ν, i))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.oscRep
commands.text:
noncomputable def oscRep (M : ℕ) : OscAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (OscPoly M) :=
  FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (fun g => if g.1 then oscCreation M g.2 else oscAnnihilation M g.2)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.omega0
commands.text:
noncomputable def omega0 (M : ℕ) : OscAlgebra M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
  (MvPolynomial.lcoeff ℂ 0) ∘ₗ (LinearMap.applyₗ (1 : OscPoly M)) ∘ₗ (oscRep M).toLinearMap

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.bogoliubovMap
commands.text:
noncomputable def bogoliubovMap (M : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) : OscAlgebra M →ₐ[ℂ] OscAlgebra M :=
  FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (fun g => (c : ℂ) • FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ g +
    (s : ℂ) • FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (!g.1, (Bosonize.A07Interactions.oppositeOrientation g.2.1, g.2.2)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.omegaP
commands.text:
noncomputable def omegaP (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) : OscAlgebra M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
  omega0 M ∘ₗ (bogoliubovMap M hp.c (-hp.s)).toLinearMap

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.wordDagger
commands.text:
def wordDagger {M : ℕ} (w : OscWord M) : OscWord M :=
  (w.map fun g => (!g.1, g.2)).reverse

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.wordElement
commands.text:
noncomputable def wordElement (M : ℕ) (w : OscWord M) : OscAlgebra M :=
  (w.map (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ)).prod

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.gramSum
commands.text:
noncomputable def gramSum (M : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (ω : OscAlgebra M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (w : Fin n → OscWord M) (z : Fin n → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i, ∑ j, star (z i) * z j * ω (wordElement M (wordDagger (w i)) * wordElement M (w j))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.vectorState
commands.text:
noncomputable def vectorState (h : ℕ) (ψ : Bosonize.A05.FockSpace σ h) (X : Bosonize.A05.Operators σ h) : ℂ :=
  inner ℂ ψ (X ψ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.compressedQR
commands.text:
def compressedQR (c s : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of ![![0, (c : ℂ), 0], ![0, 0, 0], ![(s : ℂ), 0, 0]]

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.compressedQL
commands.text:
def compressedQL (c s : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of ![![0, 0, (c : ℂ)], ![(s : ℂ), 0, 0], ![0, 0, 0]]

commands.label: def Bosonize.A08.noteCompressedPair
commands.text:
noncomputable def noteCompressedPair : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair :=
  ⟨5 / 3, 4 / 3, by norm_num⟩

Bosonize.A08.bogoliubovMap_inverse.text: theorem bogoliubovMap_inverse (M : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 - s ^ 2 = 1) : (bogoliubovMap M c s).comp (bogoliubovMap M c (-s)) = AlgHom.id ℂ (OscAlgebra M)

Bosonize.A08.bogoliubovMap_inverse_iff.text: theorem bogoliubovMap_inverse_iff (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] (c s : ℝ) : (bogoliubovMap M c s).comp (bogoliubovMap M c (-s)) = AlgHom.id ℂ (OscAlgebra M) ↔ c ^ 2 - s ^ 2 = 1

Bosonize.A08.bogoliubovMap_inverse_rev.text: theorem bogoliubovMap_inverse_rev (M : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 - s ^ 2 = 1) : (bogoliubovMap M c (-s)).comp (bogoliubovMap M c s) = AlgHom.id ℂ (OscAlgebra M)

Bosonize.A08.bogoliubovMap_word_adjoint.text: theorem bogoliubovMap_word_adjoint (M : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (w : OscWord M) (x y : OscPoly M) : oscPairing M x (oscRep M (bogoliubovMap M c s (wordElement M (wordDagger w))) y) = oscPairing M (oscRep M (bogoliubovMap M c s (wordElement M w)) x) y

Bosonize.A08.compressed_common_kernel_tr.text: theorem compressed_common_kernel_trivial (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (hs : hp.s ≠ 0) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hR : (compressedQR hp.c hp.s).mulVec v = 0) (hL : (compressedQL hp.c hp.s).mulVec v = 0) : v = 0

Bosonize.A08.compressed_gram.text: theorem compressed_gram (c s : ℝ) : (compressedQR c s)ᴴ * compressedQR c s + (compressedQL c s)ᴴ * compressedQL c s = Matrix.diagonal ![2 * (s : ℂ) ^ 2, (c : ℂ) ^ 2, (c : ℂ) ^ 2]

Bosonize.A08.compressed_no_vacuum_densit.text: theorem compressed_no_vacuum_density (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (hs : hp.s ≠ 0) : ¬ ∃ ρ : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ, compressedQR hp.c hp.s * ρ = 0 ∧ compressedQL hp.c hp.s * ρ = 0 ∧ ρ.trace = 1

Bosonize.A08.note_compressed_witness.text: theorem note_compressed_witness : (compressedQR noteCompressedPair.c noteCompressedPair.s)ᴴ * compressedQR noteCompressedPair.c noteCompressedPair.s + (compressedQL noteCompressedPair.c noteCompressedPair.s)ᴴ * compressedQL noteCompressedPair.c noteCompressedPair.s = Matrix.diagonal ![(32 : ℂ) / 9, (25 : ℂ) / 9, (25 : ℂ) / 9]

Bosonize.A08.omega0_ccr_descends.text: theorem omega0_ccr_descends (M : ℕ) (a b : OscAlgebra M) (p q : OscMode M) : omega0 M (a * (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, p) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, q) - FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, q) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, p) - (if p = q then (oscWeight p : ℂ) else 0) • 1) * b) = 0

Bosonize.A08.omega0_ccr_descends_aa.text: theorem omega0_ccr_descends_aa (M : ℕ) (a b : OscAlgebra M) (p q : OscMode M) : omega0 M (a * (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, p) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, q) - FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, q) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, p)) * b) = 0

Bosonize.A08.omega0_ccr_descends_cc.text: theorem omega0_ccr_descends_cc (M : ℕ) (a b : OscAlgebra M) (p q : OscMode M) : omega0 M (a * (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, p) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, q) - FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, q) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, p)) * b) = 0

Bosonize.A08.omega0_eq_pairing.text: theorem omega0_eq_pairing (M : ℕ) (a : OscAlgebra M) : omega0 M a = oscPairing M 1 (oscRep M a 1)

Bosonize.A08.omega0_gramSum.text: theorem omega0_gramSum (M : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → OscWord M) (z : Fin n → ℂ) : (gramSum M (omega0 M) w z).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (gramSum M (omega0 M) w z).re

Bosonize.A08.omegaP_ccr_descends.text: theorem omegaP_ccr_descends (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (a b : OscAlgebra M) (p q : OscMode M) : omegaP M hp (a * (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, p) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, q) - FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, q) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, p) - (if p = q then (oscWeight p : ℂ) else 0) • 1) * b) = 0

Bosonize.A08.omegaP_ccr_descends_aa.text: theorem omegaP_ccr_descends_aa (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (a b : OscAlgebra M) (p q : OscMode M) : omegaP M hp (a * (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, p) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, q) - FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, q) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (false, p)) * b) = 0

Bosonize.A08.omegaP_ccr_descends_cc.text: theorem omegaP_ccr_descends_cc (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (a b : OscAlgebra M) (p q : OscMode M) : omegaP M hp (a * (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, p) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, q) - FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, q) * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (true, p)) * b) = 0

Bosonize.A08.omegaP_commutator.text: theorem omegaP_commutator (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (ν : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) (i : Fin M) : omegaP M hp (annihilatorGen M ν i * creatorGen M ν i) - omegaP M hp (creatorGen M ν i * annihilatorGen M ν i) = ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)

Bosonize.A08.omegaP_comp_bogoliubovMap.text: theorem omegaP_comp_bogoliubovMap (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) : (omegaP M hp).comp (bogoliubovMap M hp.c hp.s).toLinearMap = omega0 M

Bosonize.A08.omegaP_dressed_creator_mul.text: theorem omegaP_dressed_creator_mul (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (a : OscAlgebra M) (ν : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) (i : Fin M) : omegaP M hp (bogoliubovMap M hp.c hp.s (creatorGen M ν i) * a) = 0

Bosonize.A08.omegaP_gramSum.text: theorem omegaP_gramSum (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → OscWord M) (z : Fin n → ℂ) : (gramSum M (omegaP M hp) w z).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (gramSum M (omegaP M hp) w z).re

Bosonize.A08.omegaP_mul_dressed_annihila.text: theorem omegaP_mul_dressed_annihilator (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (a : OscAlgebra M) (ν : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) (i : Fin M) : omegaP M hp (a * bogoliubovMap M hp.c hp.s (annihilatorGen M ν i)) = 0

Bosonize.A08.omegaP_one.text: theorem omegaP_one (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) : omegaP M hp 1 = 1

Bosonize.A08.oscAnnihilation_one.text: theorem oscAnnihilation_one (M : ℕ) (p : OscMode M) : oscAnnihilation M p 1 = 0

Bosonize.A08.oscCreation_pairing_adjoint.text: theorem oscCreation_pairing_adjoint (M : ℕ) (p : OscMode M) (x y : OscPoly M) : oscPairing M (oscCreation M p x) y = oscPairing M x (oscAnnihilation M p y)

Bosonize.A08.oscPairing_conj.text: theorem oscPairing_conj (M : ℕ) (p q : OscPoly M) : star (oscPairing M p q) = oscPairing M q p

Bosonize.A08.oscPairing_monomial.text: theorem oscPairing_monomial (M : ℕ) (r s : OscMode M →₀ ℕ) : oscPairing M (MvPolynomial.monomial r 1) (MvPolynomial.monomial s 1) = if r = s then (oscMonomialNorm r : ℂ) else 0

Bosonize.A08.oscPairing_self_eq_zero.text: theorem oscPairing_self_eq_zero (M : ℕ) (p : OscPoly M) : oscPairing M p p = 0 ↔ p = 0

Bosonize.A08.oscPairing_self_nonneg.text: theorem oscPairing_self_nonneg (M : ℕ) (p : OscPoly M) : 0 ≤ (oscPairing M p p).re

Bosonize.A08.osc_annihilators_commute.text: theorem osc_annihilators_commute (M : ℕ) (p q : OscMode M) : Bosonize.A02.commutator (oscAnnihilation M p) (oscAnnihilation M q) = 0

Bosonize.A08.osc_ccr.text: theorem osc_ccr (M : ℕ) (p q : OscMode M) : Bosonize.A02.commutator (oscAnnihilation M p) (oscCreation M q) = if p = q then (oscWeight p : ℂ) • (1 : Module.End ℂ (OscPoly M)) else 0

Bosonize.A08.osc_creators_commute.text: theorem osc_creators_commute (M : ℕ) (p q : OscMode M) : Bosonize.A02.commutator (oscCreation M p) (oscCreation M q) = 0

Bosonize.A08.vectorState_adjoint_mul_sel.text: theorem vectorState_adjoint_mul_self (h : ℕ) (ψ : Bosonize.A05.FockSpace σ h) (X : Bosonize.A05.Operators σ h) : vectorState h ψ (LinearMap.adjoint X * X) = ((‖X ψ‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

Bosonize.A08.vectorState_ground_one.text: theorem vectorState_ground_one (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) 1 = 1

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch19.densityKernel
commands.text:
noncomputable def densityKernel (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (c2 s2 : ℝ) (d : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  (((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 2 * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (m : ℂ) *
    ((s2 : ℂ) * Bosonize.A01.integerCharacter ζ (-(m : ℤ)) d +
     (c2 : ℂ) * Bosonize.A01.integerCharacter ζ (m : ℤ) d)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch19.oscDensityR
commands.text:
noncomputable def oscDensityR (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : Bosonize.A08.OscAlgebra M :=
  (((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) • ∑ i : Fin M,
    (Bosonize.A06.latticeCharacter h ζ (-((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) x • Bosonize.A08.creatorGen M .right i +
     Bosonize.A06.latticeCharacter h ζ ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) x • Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen M .right i)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch19.orderedDensityCorrelation
commands.text:
noncomputable def orderedDensityCorrelation (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : ℂ :=
  Bosonize.A08.omegaP M hp (oscDensityR h M ζ x * oscDensityR h M ζ y)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch19.fockDensityR
commands.text:
noncomputable def fockDensityR (h M : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) :
    Bosonize.A05.Operators σ h :=
  (((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) • ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    (Bosonize.A06.latticeCharacter h ζ (-(m : ℤ)) x • Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (m : ℤ) +
     Bosonize.A06.latticeCharacter h ζ (m : ℤ) x • Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (-(m : ℤ)))

Bosonize.Ch19.c_sq_eq_luttinger.text: theorem c_sq_eq_luttinger (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) : hp.c ^ 2 = (Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG hp + (Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG hp)⁻¹ + 2) / 4

Bosonize.Ch19.concrete_correlation_witne.text: theorem concrete_correlation_witness : Bosonize.A08.omegaP 2 Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair (Bosonize.A08.creatorGen 2 .right (1 : Fin 2) * Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen 2 .right (1 : Fin 2)) = (9 : ℂ) / 8 ∧ Bosonize.A08.omegaP 2 Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair (Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen 2 .right (1 : Fin 2) * Bosonize.A08.creatorGen 2 .right (1 : Fin 2)) = (25 : ℂ) / 8 ∧ Bosonize.A08.omegaP 2 Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair (Bosonize.A08.creatorGen 2 .right (1 : Fin 2) * Bosonize.A08.creatorGen 2 .left (1 : Fin 2)) = -(15 : ℂ) / 8 ∧ orderedDensityCorrelation 8 2 (Bosonize.A01.canonicalRoot (2 * 8)) Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair 0 0 = (51 : ℂ) / 2048 ∧ Bosonize.A06.branchMargins 8 2 0 Bosonize.Ch18.concreteNs Bosonize.Ch18.concreteBranches ∧ Bosonize.A08.vectorState 8 (Bosonize.A05.groundKet 8 Bosonize.Ch18.concreteNs) (Bosonize.A05.rho 8 0 (-2) * Bosonize.A05.rho 8 0 2) = 2 ∧ Bosonize.A08.vectorState 8 (Bosonize.A05.groundKet 8 Bosonize.Ch18.concreteNs) (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator 8 2 Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair.c Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair.s Bosonize.Ch18.concreteBranches .right * Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator 8 2 Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair.c Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair.s Bosonize.Ch18.concreteBranches .right) = (9 : ℂ) / 8 ∧ Bosonize.A08.vectorState 8 (Bosonize.A05.groundKet 8 Bosonize.Ch18.concreteNs) (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator 8 2 Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair.c Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair.s Bosonize.Ch18.concreteBranches .right * Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator 8 2 Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair.c Bosonize.Ch18.concretePair.s Bosonize.Ch18.concreteBranches .right) ≠ 0 ∧ Bosonize.A08.vectorState 8 (Bosonize.A05.groundKet 8 Bosonize.Ch18.concreteNs) (fockDensityR 8 2 (Bosonize.A01.canonicalRoot (2 * 8)) Bosonize.Ch18.concreteBranches 0 * fockDensityR 8 2 (Bosonize.A01.canonicalRoot (2 * 8)) Bosonize.Ch18.concreteBranches 0) = (3 : ℂ) / 256

Bosonize.Ch19.density_commutator_expecta.text: theorem density_commutator_expectation (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ hp x y - orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ hp y x = densityKernel h M ζ 1 (-1) ((x.val : ℤ) - (y.val : ℤ))

Bosonize.Ch19.density_kernel_diagonal.text: theorem density_kernel_diagonal (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) : orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ hp x x = ((((hp.c ^ 2 + hp.s ^ 2) * ((M * (M + 1) : ℝ) / 2) / ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))

Bosonize.Ch19.density_kernel_diagonal_po.text: theorem density_kernel_diagonal_pos (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (x : ZMod (2 * h)) (hh : 0 < h) (hM : 1 ≤ M) : 0 < (orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ hp x x).re

Bosonize.Ch19.excited_ket_norm_sq.text: theorem excited_ket_norm_sq (h M m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (η : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.marginAt h M 0 Ns (Bosonize.A06.speciesOf branches η)) : ‖Bosonize.Ch16.excitedKet h Ns branches η m‖ ^ 2 = (m : ℝ)

Bosonize.Ch19.fock_ground_density_kernel.text: theorem fock_ground_density_kernel (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.marginAt h M 0 Ns branches.rightSpecies) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : Bosonize.A08.vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) (fockDensityR h M ζ branches x * fockDensityR h M ζ branches y) = densityKernel h M ζ 1 0 ((x.val : ℤ) - (y.val : ℤ))

Bosonize.Ch19.fock_ground_matches_free_s.text: theorem fock_ground_matches_free_state (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (hh : 0 < h) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.marginAt h M 0 Ns branches.rightSpecies) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : Bosonize.A08.vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) (fockDensityR h M ζ branches x * fockDensityR h M ζ branches y) = orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ freePair x y

Bosonize.Ch19.ground_dressed_number.text: theorem ground_dressed_number (h M m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (η : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.branchMargins h M 0 Ns branches) : Bosonize.A08.vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m hp.c hp.s branches η * Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches η) = (m : ℂ) * (hp.s : ℂ) ^ 2

Bosonize.Ch19.ground_dressed_reverse.text: theorem ground_dressed_reverse (h M m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (η : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.branchMargins h M 0 Ns branches) : Bosonize.A08.vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches η * Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m hp.c hp.s branches η) = (m : ℂ) * (hp.c : ℂ) ^ 2

Bosonize.Ch19.ground_lowering_lowering.text: theorem ground_lowering_lowering (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (m n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) : Bosonize.A08.vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) (Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (-(m : ℤ)) * Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (-(n : ℤ))) = 0

Bosonize.Ch19.ground_lowering_raising.text: theorem ground_lowering_raising (h M : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hnM : n ≤ M) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.marginAt h M 0 Ns branches.rightSpecies) : Bosonize.A08.vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) (Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (-(m : ℤ)) * Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (n : ℤ)) = if m = n then (m : ℂ) else 0

Bosonize.Ch19.ground_not_dressed_vacuum.text: theorem ground_not_dressed_vacuum (h M m : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (hs : hp.s ≠ 0) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (η : Bosonize.A06.Orientation) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) (hmargin : Bosonize.A06.branchMargins h M 0 Ns branches) : Bosonize.A08.vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) (Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m hp.c hp.s branches η * Bosonize.A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m hp.c hp.s branches η) ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch19.ground_raising_lowering.text: theorem ground_raising_lowering (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (m n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) : Bosonize.A08.vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) (Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (m : ℤ) * Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (-(n : ℤ))) = 0

Bosonize.Ch19.ground_raising_raising.text: theorem ground_raising_raising (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (branches : Bosonize.A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : Bosonize.A05.admissible h Ns) : Bosonize.A08.vectorState h (Bosonize.A05.groundKet h Ns) (Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (m : ℤ) * Bosonize.A05.rho h branches.rightSpecies (n : ℤ)) = 0

Bosonize.Ch19.omegaP_annihilator_annihil.text: theorem omegaP_annihilator_annihilator_right (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (i j : Fin M) : Bosonize.A08.omegaP M hp (Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen M .right i * Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen M .right j) = 0

Bosonize.Ch19.omegaP_annihilator_creator.text: theorem omegaP_annihilator_creator_right (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (i j : Fin M) : Bosonize.A08.omegaP M hp (Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen M .right i * Bosonize.A08.creatorGen M .right j) = if i = j then ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (hp.c : ℂ) ^ 2 else 0

Bosonize.Ch19.omegaP_creator_annihilator.text: theorem omegaP_creator_annihilator_right (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (i j : Fin M) : Bosonize.A08.omegaP M hp (Bosonize.A08.creatorGen M .right i * Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen M .right j) = if i = j then ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (hp.s : ℂ) ^ 2 else 0

Bosonize.Ch19.omegaP_creator_creator_rig.text: theorem omegaP_creator_creator_right (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (i j : Fin M) : Bosonize.A08.omegaP M hp (Bosonize.A08.creatorGen M .right i * Bosonize.A08.creatorGen M .right j) = 0

Bosonize.Ch19.omegaP_cross_annihilator_a.text: theorem omegaP_cross_annihilator_annihilator (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (i j : Fin M) : Bosonize.A08.omegaP M hp (Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen M .right i * Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen M .left j) = if i = j then -(((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (hp.c : ℂ) * (hp.s : ℂ)) else 0

Bosonize.Ch19.omegaP_cross_creator_annih.text: theorem omegaP_cross_creator_annihilator (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (i j : Fin M) : Bosonize.A08.omegaP M hp (Bosonize.A08.creatorGen M .right i * Bosonize.A08.annihilatorGen M .left j) = 0

Bosonize.Ch19.omegaP_cross_creator_creat.text: theorem omegaP_cross_creator_creator (M : ℕ) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (i j : Fin M) : Bosonize.A08.omegaP M hp (Bosonize.A08.creatorGen M .right i * Bosonize.A08.creatorGen M .left j) = if i = j then -(((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (hp.c : ℂ) * (hp.s : ℂ)) else 0

Bosonize.Ch19.ordered_density_free.text: theorem ordered_density_free (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (hs : hp.s = 0) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ hp x y = densityKernel h M ζ 1 0 ((x.val : ℤ) - (y.val : ℤ))

Bosonize.Ch19.ordered_density_kernel.text: theorem ordered_density_kernel (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ hp x y = densityKernel h M ζ (hp.c ^ 2) (hp.s ^ 2) ((x.val : ℤ) - (y.val : ℤ))

Bosonize.Ch19.ordered_density_kernel_lat.text: theorem ordered_density_kernel_lattice (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (2 * h)) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ hp x y = (((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 2 * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (m : ℂ) * ((hp.s : ℂ) ^ 2 * Bosonize.A06.latticeCharacter h ζ (-(m : ℤ)) (x - y) + (hp.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * Bosonize.A06.latticeCharacter h ζ (m : ℤ) (x - y))

Bosonize.Ch19.s_sq_eq_luttinger.text: theorem s_sq_eq_luttinger (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) : hp.s ^ 2 = (Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG hp + (Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG hp)⁻¹ - 2) / 4

Bosonize.Ch19.symmetrized_density_kernel.text: theorem symmetrized_density_kernel (h M : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * h)] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (hp : Bosonize.Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (x y : ZMod (2 * h)) : (orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ hp x y + orderedDensityCorrelation h M ζ hp y x) / 2 = densityKernel h M ζ ((Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG hp + (Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG hp)⁻¹) / 4) ((Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG hp + (Bosonize.Ch18.luttingerG hp)⁻¹) / 4) ((x.val : ℤ) - (y.val : ℤ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.raiseCharge
commands.text:
noncomputable def raiseCharge (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : σ → ℤ :=
  Function.update Ns ν (Ns ν + 1)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.reflectLeft
commands.text:
noncomputable def reflectLeft (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : σ → ℤ :=
  Function.update Ns branches.leftSpecies (-(Ns branches.leftSpecies))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.cdwTarget
commands.text:
noncomputable def cdwTarget (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : σ → ℤ :=
  raiseCharge (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) branches.rightSpecies

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.scTarget
commands.text:
noncomputable def scTarget (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : σ → ℤ :=
  Ch13.lowerCharge (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) branches.rightSpecies

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.cdwShift
commands.text:
noncomputable def cdwShift (branches : A06.Branches σ) (ν : σ) : ℤ :=
  (if ν = branches.rightSpecies then (1 : ℤ) else 0) -
    (if ν = branches.leftSpecies then (1 : ℤ) else 0)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.scShift
commands.text:
noncomputable def scShift (branches : A06.Branches σ) (ν : σ) : ℤ :=
  -(if ν = branches.rightSpecies then (1 : ℤ) else 0) -
    (if ν = branches.leftSpecies then (1 : ℤ) else 0)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.fieldOf
commands.text:
noncomputable def fieldOf (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h))
    (ν : σ) (x : ℤ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  A05.liftedAnnihilation h b ν x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.orderCDW
commands.text:
noncomputable def orderCDW (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h))
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  LinearMap.adjoint (fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x) *
    fieldOf h b branches.leftSpecies x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.orderSC
commands.text:
noncomputable def orderSC (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h))
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) : A05.Operators σ h :=
  fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x * fieldOf h b branches.leftSpecies x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.cdwResidualOp
commands.text:
noncomputable def cdwResidualOp (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h))
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (Km : ℕ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  LinearMap.adjoint (fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x) *
    (1 - Ch14.projection h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) Km) *
    fieldOf h b branches.leftSpecies x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.scResidualOp
commands.text:
noncomputable def scResidualOp (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h))
    (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (Km : ℕ) :
    A05.Operators σ h :=
  fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x *
    (1 - Ch14.projection h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) Km) *
    fieldOf h b branches.leftSpecies x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.cdwChargeCoeff
commands.text:
noncomputable def cdwChargeCoeff (h : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ)
    (Ns : σ → ℤ) (x : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot (2 * h))
      (Ns branches.leftSpecies - Ns branches.rightSpecies - 1) x *
    (Ch13.kleinPhase h Ns branches.leftSpecies *
      Ch13.kleinPhase h (cdwTarget branches Ns) branches.rightSpecies)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.scChargeCoeff
commands.text:
noncomputable def scChargeCoeff (h : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ)
    (Ns : σ → ℤ) (x : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot (2 * h))
      (Ns branches.rightSpecies + Ns branches.leftSpecies) x *
    (Ch13.kleinPhase h Ns branches.leftSpecies *
      Ch13.kleinPhase h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies)
        branches.rightSpecies)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.dualPair
commands.text:
def dualPair (hp : Ch18.HyperbolicPair) : Ch18.HyperbolicPair where
  c := hp.c
  s := -hp.s
  hyperbolic_id := by simpa only [neg_sq] using hp.hyperbolic_id

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.dualParams
commands.text:
def dualParams {v1 v2 : ℝ}
    (lp : A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) :
    A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 (-v2) where
  u := lp.u
  c := lp.c
  s := -lp.s
  u_pos := lp.u_pos
  c_pos := lp.c_pos
  u_sq := by simpa only [neg_sq] using lp.u_sq
  hyperbolic_id := by simpa only [neg_sq] using lp.hyperbolic_id
  match_v1 := by simpa only [neg_sq] using lp.match_v1
  match_v2 := by
    simpa only [mul_neg] using congrArg Neg.neg lp.match_v2

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch20.ModeFamily
commands.text:
abbrev ModeFamily (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] :=
  A06.Orientation → ℤ → Module.End ℂ E

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.speciesFamily
commands.text:
noncomputable def speciesFamily {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ]
    (h : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : ModeFamily (A05.FockSpace σ h) :=
  fun η k => A05.rho h (A06.speciesOf branches η) k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.dualFamily
commands.text:
def dualFamily {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E]
    (ρ : ModeFamily E) : ModeFamily E :=
  fun η k => match η with
    | .right => -ρ .right k
    | .left => ρ .left k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.dressedCreatorOf
commands.text:
noncomputable def dressedCreatorOf {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E]
    (ρ : ModeFamily E) (c s : ℝ) (η : A06.Orientation) (m : ℕ) :
    Module.End ℂ E :=
  (c : ℂ) • ρ η (m : ℤ) +
    (s : ℂ) • ρ (A07Interactions.oppositeOrientation η) (-(m : ℤ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.dressedAnnihilatorOf
commands.text:
noncomputable def dressedAnnihilatorOf {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E]
    (ρ : ModeFamily E) (c s : ℝ) (η : A06.Orientation) (m : ℕ) :
    Module.End ℂ E :=
  (c : ℂ) • ρ η (-(m : ℤ)) +
    (s : ℂ) • ρ (A07Interactions.oppositeOrientation η) (m : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.pairingModeOf
commands.text:
noncomputable def pairingModeOf {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E]
    (ρ : ModeFamily E) (m : ℕ) (v1 v2 : ℝ) : Module.End ℂ E :=
  (v1 : ℂ) •
      (ρ .right (m : ℤ) * ρ .right (-(m : ℤ)) +
       ρ .left (m : ℤ) * ρ .left (-(m : ℤ))) +
    (v2 : ℂ) •
      (ρ .right (m : ℤ) * ρ .left (m : ℤ) +
       ρ .right (-(m : ℤ)) * ρ .left (-(m : ℤ)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.chiralPhaseOf
commands.text:
noncomputable def chiralPhaseOf {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E]
    (ρ : ModeFamily E) (h M : ℕ) (c s : ℝ)
    (η : A06.Orientation) (x : ℤ) : Module.End ℂ E :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    ((m : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot (2 * h))
          (-(A06.orientationSign η) * (m : ℤ)) x •
          dressedCreatorOf ρ c s η m +
       A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot (2 * h))
          (A06.orientationSign η * (m : ℤ)) x •
          dressedAnnihilatorOf ρ c s η m)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.xCDWOf
commands.text:
noncomputable def xCDWOf {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E]
    (ρ : ModeFamily E) (h M : ℕ) (hp : Ch18.HyperbolicPair)
    (x : ℤ) : Module.End ℂ E :=
  ((hp.c - hp.s : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    (chiralPhaseOf ρ h M hp.c hp.s .right x +
      chiralPhaseOf ρ h M hp.c hp.s .left x)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.xSCOf
commands.text:
noncomputable def xSCOf {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E]
    (ρ : ModeFamily E) (h M : ℕ) (hp : Ch18.HyperbolicPair)
    (x : ℤ) : Module.End ℂ E :=
  ((hp.c + hp.s : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    (chiralPhaseOf ρ h M hp.c hp.s .right x -
      chiralPhaseOf ρ h M hp.c hp.s .left x)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch20.logKernel
commands.text:
noncomputable def logKernel (h M : ℕ) (x y : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    (1 - Real.cos
      ((2 * Real.pi * (m : ℝ) * ((x - y : ℤ) : ℝ)) /
        ((2 * h : ℕ) : ℝ))) / (m : ℝ)

Bosonize.Ch20.ambient_cdw_residual.text: lemma ambient_cdw_residual (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (Ks Km Kt : ℕ) : Ch14.projection h (cdwTarget branches Ns) Kt * orderCDW h b branches x * Ch14.projection h Ns Ks = Ch14.projection h (cdwTarget branches Ns) Kt * LinearMap.adjoint (fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x) * Ch14.projection h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) Km * fieldOf h b branches.leftSpecies x * Ch14.projection h Ns Ks + Ch14.projection h (cdwTarget branches Ns) Kt * cdwResidualOp h b branches x Ns Km * Ch14.projection h Ns Ks

Bosonize.Ch20.ambient_sc_residual.text: lemma ambient_sc_residual (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (Ks Km Kt : ℕ) : Ch14.projection h (scTarget branches Ns) Kt * orderSC h b branches x * Ch14.projection h Ns Ks = Ch14.projection h (scTarget branches Ns) Kt * fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x * Ch14.projection h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) Km * fieldOf h b branches.leftSpecies x * Ch14.projection h Ns Ks + Ch14.projection h (scTarget branches Ns) Kt * scResidualOp h b branches x Ns Km * Ch14.projection h Ns Ks

Bosonize.Ch20.cdwChargeCoeff_norm.text: lemma cdwChargeCoeff_norm (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (x : ℤ) : ‖cdwChargeCoeff h branches Ns x‖ = 1

Bosonize.Ch20.cdwTarget_apply.text: lemma cdwTarget_apply (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : cdwTarget branches Ns ν = Ns ν + cdwShift branches ν

Bosonize.Ch20.cdwTarget_lower_right.text: lemma cdwTarget_lower_right (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : Ch13.lowerCharge (cdwTarget branches Ns) branches.rightSpecies = Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies

Bosonize.Ch20.cdwTarget_reverse_shift.text: lemma cdwTarget_reverse_shift (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : cdwTarget branches (raiseCharge (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.rightSpecies) branches.leftSpecies) = Ns

Bosonize.Ch20.cdw_charge_duality.text: lemma cdw_charge_duality (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (x : ℤ) : cdwChargeCoeff h branches (reflectLeft branches Ns) x = A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot (2 * h)) 1 x * star (scChargeCoeff h branches (raiseCharge (raiseCharge Ns branches.rightSpecies) branches.leftSpecies) x)

Bosonize.Ch20.cdw_creation_factor_eq_bud.text: lemma cdw_creation_factor_eq_budgetAdjoint (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (Km Kt : ℕ) : Ch14.projectedMap h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) (cdwTarget branches Ns) Km Kt (LinearMap.adjoint (fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x)) = Ch14.budgetAdjoint h (cdwTarget branches Ns) (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) Kt Km (Ch14.projectedMap h (cdwTarget branches Ns) (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) Kt Km (fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x))

Bosonize.Ch20.cdw_target_dual.text: lemma cdw_target_dual (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : reflectLeft branches (cdwTarget branches (reflectLeft branches Ns)) = raiseCharge (raiseCharge Ns branches.rightSpecies) branches.leftSpecies

Bosonize.Ch20.concrete_cdw_coefficient.text: lemma concrete_cdw_coefficient : cdwChargeCoeff 2 Ch16.standardBranches witnessZero 1 = Complex.I

Bosonize.Ch20.concrete_discarded_channel.text: lemma concrete_discarded_channel_nonzero : Ch14.projectedMap 2 witnessZero (cdwTarget Ch16.standardBranches witnessZero) 0 1 (cdwResidualOp 2 (fun _ => Ch06Ext.periodicTwist 4) Ch16.standardBranches 1 witnessZero 0) (Ch14.groundVector 2 (by decide) witnessZero witnessZero_admissible 0) ≠ 0

lemma concrete_discarded_channel_target_zero : Ch14.projectedMap 2 witnessZero (cdwTarget Ch16.standardBranches witnessZero) 0 0 (cdwResidualOp 2 (fun _ => Ch06Ext.periodicTwist 4) Ch16.standardBranches 1 witnessZero 0) (Ch14.groundVector 2 (by decide) witnessZero witnessZero_admissible 0) = 0

Bosonize.Ch20.concrete_linear_mu_counter.text: lemma concrete_linear_mu_counterexample : Ch17.zeroModeEnergyScalar 1 1 0 0 1 Ch16.standardBranches (![0, 1] : Fin 2 → ℤ) ≠ Ch17.zeroModeEnergyScalar 1 1 0 0 1 Ch16.standardBranches (![0, -1] : Fin 2 → ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch20.concrete_order_witness_cdw.text: lemma concrete_order_witness_cdw : inner ℂ (A05.groundKet 2 (cdwTarget Ch16.standardBranches witnessZero)) (orderCDW 2 (fun _ => Ch06Ext.periodicTwist 4) Ch16.standardBranches 1 (A05.groundKet 2 witnessZero)) = Complex.I / 4

Bosonize.Ch20.concrete_order_witness_sc.text: lemma concrete_order_witness_sc : inner ℂ (A05.groundKet 2 (scTarget Ch16.standardBranches witnessSC)) (orderSC 2 (fun _ => Ch06Ext.periodicTwist 4) Ch16.standardBranches 1 (A05.groundKet 2 witnessSC)) = Complex.I / 4

Bosonize.Ch20.concrete_pairing_duality_n.text: lemma concrete_pairing_duality_nontrivial : pairingModeOf (speciesFamily 8 Ch16.standardBranches) 1 17 15 (A05.groundKet 8 Ch18.concreteNs) ≠ pairingModeOf (speciesFamily 8 Ch16.standardBranches) 1 17 (-15) (A05.groundKet 8 Ch18.concreteNs)

Bosonize.Ch20.concrete_sc_coefficient.text: lemma concrete_sc_coefficient : scChargeCoeff 2 Ch16.standardBranches witnessSC 1 = Complex.I

Bosonize.Ch20.dressedAnnihilatorOf_speci.text: lemma dressedAnnihilatorOf_species {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h m : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) : dressedAnnihilatorOf (speciesFamily h branches) c s η m = A07Interactions.bogoliubovAnnihilator h m c s branches η

Bosonize.Ch20.dressedCreatorOf_species.text: lemma dressedCreatorOf_species {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h m : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (η : A06.Orientation) : dressedCreatorOf (speciesFamily h branches) c s η m = A07Interactions.bogoliubovCreator h m c s branches η

Bosonize.Ch20.dualFamily_involutive.text: lemma dualFamily_involutive {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) : dualFamily (dualFamily ρ) = ρ

Bosonize.Ch20.dualPair_involutive.text: lemma dualPair_involutive (hp : Ch18.HyperbolicPair) : dualPair (dualPair hp) = hp

Bosonize.Ch20.dualParams_involutive.text: lemma dualParams_involutive {v1 v2 : ℝ} (lp : A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : (dualParams (dualParams lp)).u = lp.u ∧ (dualParams (dualParams lp)).c = lp.c ∧ (dualParams (dualParams lp)).s = lp.s

Bosonize.Ch20.dualParams_pair.text: lemma dualParams_pair {v1 v2 : ℝ} (lp : A07Interactions.HyperbolicParams v1 v2) : Ch18.HyperbolicPair.ofParams (dualParams lp) = dualPair (Ch18.HyperbolicPair.ofParams lp)

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_canonical_mu_zero_mod.text: lemma dual_canonical_mu_zero_mode {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h : ℕ) (vF g4 g2 : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : Ch17.zeroModeEnergyScalar h vF g4 g2 (Ch17.canonicalMu h vF) branches (reflectLeft branches Ns) = Ch17.zeroModeEnergyScalar h vF g4 (-g2) (Ch17.canonicalMu h vF) branches Ns

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_chiralPhase_left.text: lemma dual_chiralPhase_left {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (h M : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (x : ℤ) : chiralPhaseOf (dualFamily ρ) h M c s .left x = chiralPhaseOf ρ h M c (-s) .left x

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_chiralPhase_right.text: lemma dual_chiralPhase_right {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (h M : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (x : ℤ) : chiralPhaseOf (dualFamily ρ) h M c s .right x = -chiralPhaseOf ρ h M c (-s) .right x

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_commutator.text: lemma dual_commutator {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (η η' : A06.Orientation) (m n : ℤ) : A02.commutator (dualFamily ρ η m) (dualFamily ρ η' n) = (if η = η' then (1 : ℂ) else -1) • A02.commutator (ρ η m) (ρ η' n)

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_dressed_annihilator_l.text: lemma dual_dressed_annihilator_left {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (c s : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : dressedAnnihilatorOf (dualFamily ρ) c s .left m = dressedAnnihilatorOf ρ c (-s) .left m

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_dressed_annihilator_r.text: lemma dual_dressed_annihilator_right {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (c s : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : dressedAnnihilatorOf (dualFamily ρ) c s .right m = -dressedAnnihilatorOf ρ c (-s) .right m

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_dressed_creator_left.text: lemma dual_dressed_creator_left {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (c s : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : dressedCreatorOf (dualFamily ρ) c s .left m = dressedCreatorOf ρ c (-s) .left m

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_dressed_creator_right.text: lemma dual_dressed_creator_right {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (c s : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : dressedCreatorOf (dualFamily ρ) c s .right m = -dressedCreatorOf ρ c (-s) .right m

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_pairingMode.text: lemma dual_pairingMode {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (m : ℕ) (v1 v2 : ℝ) : pairingModeOf (dualFamily ρ) m v1 v2 = pairingModeOf ρ m v1 (-v2)

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_symmetric_zero_mode.text: lemma dual_symmetric_zero_mode {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h : ℕ) (vF g4 g2 : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : Ch17.symmetricZeroModeScalar h vF g4 g2 branches (reflectLeft branches Ns) = Ch17.symmetricZeroModeScalar h vF g4 (-g2) branches Ns

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_xCDW.text: lemma dual_xCDW {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (h M : ℕ) (hp : Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (x : ℤ) : xCDWOf (dualFamily ρ) h M hp x = -xSCOf ρ h M (dualPair hp) x

Bosonize.Ch20.dual_xSC.text: lemma dual_xSC {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] (ρ : ModeFamily E) (h M : ℕ) (hp : Ch18.HyperbolicPair) (x : ℤ) : xSCOf (dualFamily ρ) h M hp x = -xCDWOf ρ h M (dualPair hp) x

Bosonize.Ch20.klein_reflect_left.text: lemma klein_reflect_left (h : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : Ch13.kleinPhase h (reflectLeft branches Ns) branches.leftSpecies = -Ch13.kleinPhase h (raiseCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) branches.leftSpecies

Bosonize.Ch20.klein_reflect_right.text: lemma klein_reflect_right (h : ℕ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : Ch13.kleinPhase h (reflectLeft branches Ns) branches.rightSpecies = Ch13.kleinPhase h Ns branches.rightSpecies

Bosonize.Ch20.logKernel_nonneg.text: lemma logKernel_nonneg (h M : ℕ) (x y : ℤ) : 0 ≤ logKernel h M x y

Bosonize.Ch20.logKernel_self.text: lemma logKernel_self (h M : ℕ) (x : ℤ) : logKernel h M x x = 0

Bosonize.Ch20.logKernel_symm.text: lemma logKernel_symm (h M : ℕ) (x y : ℤ) : logKernel h M x y = logKernel h M y x

Bosonize.Ch20.lowerCharge_raiseCharge.text: lemma lowerCharge_raiseCharge (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : Ch13.lowerCharge (raiseCharge Ns ν) ν = Ns

Bosonize.Ch20.luttingerGInv_dual.text: lemma luttingerGInv_dual (hp : Ch18.HyperbolicPair) : Ch18.luttingerGInv (dualPair hp) = Ch18.luttingerG hp

Bosonize.Ch20.luttingerG_dual.text: lemma luttingerG_dual (hp : Ch18.HyperbolicPair) : Ch18.luttingerG (dualPair hp) = Ch18.luttingerGInv hp

Bosonize.Ch20.orderCDW_charge_commutator.text: lemma orderCDW_charge_commutator (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) (ν : σ) : A02.commutator (A05.chargeObservable h ν) (orderCDW h b branches x) = ((cdwShift branches ν : ℤ) : ℂ) • orderCDW h b branches x

Bosonize.Ch20.orderCDW_ground_coeff.text: lemma orderCDW_ground_coeff (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hR : Ns branches.rightSpecies < (h : ℤ)) (hL : -(h : ℤ) < Ns branches.leftSpecies) (x : ℤ) : inner ℂ (A05.groundKet h (cdwTarget branches Ns)) (orderCDW h (fun _ => Ch06Ext.periodicTwist (2 * h)) branches x (A05.groundKet h Ns)) = (((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) * cdwChargeCoeff h branches Ns x

Bosonize.Ch20.orderSC_charge_commutator.text: lemma orderSC_charge_commutator (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) (ν : σ) : A02.commutator (A05.chargeObservable h ν) (orderSC h b branches x) = ((scShift branches ν : ℤ) : ℂ) • orderSC h b branches x

Bosonize.Ch20.orderSC_ground_coeff.text: lemma orderSC_ground_coeff (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (hN : A05.admissible h Ns) (hR : -(h : ℤ) < Ns branches.rightSpecies) (hL : -(h : ℤ) < Ns branches.leftSpecies) (x : ℤ) : inner ℂ (A05.groundKet h (scTarget branches Ns)) (orderSC h (fun _ => Ch06Ext.periodicTwist (2 * h)) branches x (A05.groundKet h Ns)) = (((2 * h : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) * scChargeCoeff h branches Ns x

Bosonize.Ch20.pairingModeOf_species.text: lemma pairingModeOf_species {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (h m : ℕ) (v1 v2 : ℝ) (branches : A06.Branches σ) : pairingModeOf (speciesFamily h branches) m v1 v2 = A07Interactions.pairingMode h m v1 v2 branches

Bosonize.Ch20.projected_cdw_residual.text: lemma projected_cdw_residual (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (Ks Km Kt : ℕ) : Ch14.projectedMap h Ns (cdwTarget branches Ns) Ks Kt (orderCDW h b branches x) = (Ch14.projectedMap h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) (cdwTarget branches Ns) Km Kt (LinearMap.adjoint (fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x))).comp (Ch14.projectedMap h Ns (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) Ks Km (fieldOf h b branches.leftSpecies x)) + Ch14.projectedMap h Ns (cdwTarget branches Ns) Ks Kt (cdwResidualOp h b branches x Ns Km)

Bosonize.Ch20.projected_sc_residual.text: lemma projected_sc_residual (h : ℕ) (b : σ → Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist (2 * h)) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (x : ℤ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (Ks Km Kt : ℕ) : Ch14.projectedMap h Ns (scTarget branches Ns) Ks Kt (orderSC h b branches x) = (Ch14.projectedMap h (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) (scTarget branches Ns) Km Kt (fieldOf h b branches.rightSpecies x)).comp (Ch14.projectedMap h Ns (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.leftSpecies) Ks Km (fieldOf h b branches.leftSpecies x)) + Ch14.projectedMap h Ns (scTarget branches Ns) Ks Kt (scResidualOp h b branches x Ns Km)

Bosonize.Ch20.raiseCharge_lowerCharge.text: lemma raiseCharge_lowerCharge (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : raiseCharge (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns ν) ν = Ns

Bosonize.Ch20.reflectLeft_involutive.text: lemma reflectLeft_involutive (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : reflectLeft branches (reflectLeft branches Ns) = Ns

Bosonize.Ch20.scChargeCoeff_norm.text: lemma scChargeCoeff_norm (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (x : ℤ) : ‖scChargeCoeff h branches Ns x‖ = 1

Bosonize.Ch20.scTarget_apply.text: lemma scTarget_apply (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (ν : σ) : scTarget branches Ns ν = Ns ν + scShift branches ν

Bosonize.Ch20.scTarget_reverse_double_ra.text: lemma scTarget_reverse_double_raise (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : scTarget branches (raiseCharge (raiseCharge Ns branches.rightSpecies) branches.leftSpecies) = Ns

Bosonize.Ch20.sc_charge_duality.text: lemma sc_charge_duality (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (x : ℤ) : scChargeCoeff h branches (reflectLeft branches Ns) x = A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot (2 * h)) 1 x * star (cdwChargeCoeff h branches (raiseCharge (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.rightSpecies) branches.leftSpecies) x)

Bosonize.Ch20.sc_target_dual.text: lemma sc_target_dual (branches : A06.Branches σ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) : reflectLeft branches (scTarget branches (reflectLeft branches Ns)) = raiseCharge (Ch13.lowerCharge Ns branches.rightSpecies) branches.leftSpecies
